sessions.title: "Alpha Point" UE5 Demo: Unlocking Artist Potential (Presented by Epic Games - Unreal Engine)

summary.en: The Coalition shares lessons from an Unreal Engine 5 evaluation demo on Xbox Series X.
summary.zh: The Coalition 分享在 Xbox Series X 制作虚幻引擎5评估演示的经验。

sessions.title: "Swiping on the Six Strings": Crafting an Interactive Guitar in 'The Last of Us: Part II'

summary.en: The Last of Us Part II explores designing its interactive guitar from musical and gameplay perspectives.
summary.zh: 《最后生还者 第二部》从音乐与玩法角度，介绍互动吉他的设计。

sessions.title: #1ReasonToBe

summary.en: Women from different countries share personal reasons and experiences behind their game-development careers.
summary.zh: 来自不同国家的女性，分享从事游戏开发的个人动机与经历。

sessions.title: 'Disco Elysium': Meaningless Choices and Impractical Advice

summary.en: A Disco Elysium writer reflects on advice the team challenged during narrative development.
summary.zh: 《极乐迪斯科》编剧回顾叙事开发中，团队如何质疑和取舍收到的建议。

sessions.title: 'Final Fantasy VII' Remake: Automating Quality Assurance and the Tools for the Future

summary.en: Final Fantasy VII Remake discusses QA automation and tools for managing growing testing demands.
summary.zh: 《最终幻想VII 重制版》分享通过 QA 自动化和工具应对不断增长的测试需求。

sessions.title: 'Genshin Impact': Building a Scalable AI System

summary.en: Genshin Impact describes programming approaches for improving AI-system scalability in an open world.
summary.zh: 《原神》介绍用于提升开放世界 AI 系统可扩展性的程序设计方法。

sessions.title: 'Genshin Impact': Crafting an Anime Style Open World

summary.en: Genshin Impact's producer discusses building a distinctive anime-style open world.
summary.zh: 《原神》制作人分享构建具有辨识度的动画风格开放世界的思路。

youtube.title: 'Genshin Impact': Crafting an Anime-Style Open World

sessions.title: 'Homefront' to 'God of War': Using Music to Build Suspense
sessions.title_zh: 从《Homefront》到《战神》：用音乐营造悬念

summary.en: Winifred Phillips examines how dissonance, drones, silence and sound-design techniques can shape musical tension. Examples from Homefront, God of War and Dragon Front connect these choices to suspense in conventional and VR games.
summary.zh: Winifred Phillips 结合《Homefront》《战神》和《Dragon Front》的配乐，讨论不协和音、持续音、突发声响与留白如何制造紧张感，并延伸到 VR 中的悬念表达。

sessions.title: 'Marvel's Spider-Man Miles Morales': Beginning a New Adventure

summary.en: Miles Morales examines collaboration between narrative and design in its opening thirty minutes.
summary.zh: 《迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯》分析开场三十分钟中叙事与玩法设计的协作。

sessions.title: 'Marvel's Spider-Man Miles Morales': The Creative Journey

summary.en: Insomniac traces Miles Morales's creative development from early ideas to finished execution.
summary.zh: Insomniac 回顾《迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯》从早期构想到最终实现的创作过程。

youtube.title: Marvel's Spider-Man Miles Morales: The Creative Journey

sessions.title: 'Mutazione' Visualised

summary.en: Mutazione's artists discuss building a coherent, believable world despite its fantastical characters.
summary.zh: 《Mutazione》美术团队讨论如何为奇幻角色构建统一、可信的游戏世界。

sessions.title: 'Ori Will of the Wisps': Narrative Design and Visual Storytelling

summary.en: Moon Studios discusses narrative techniques and visual storytelling in Ori and the Will of the Wisps.
summary.zh: Moon Studios 分享《奥日与萤火意志》的叙事技巧与视觉讲故事方式。

sessions.title: 'Resident Evil Village': Our Approach to Game Design, Art Direction, and Graphics

summary.en: Resident Evil Village connects game design, art direction, and graphics with its intended emotional experience.
summary.zh: 《生化危机8：村庄》介绍玩法、艺术指导与图形技术如何服务预期情绪体验。

sessions.title: 'Sea of Solitude': Game Design Based on Human Emotions

summary.en: Sea of Solitude examines game design built around loneliness and other personal emotional experiences.
summary.zh: 《孤独之海》探讨围绕孤独感等个人情感经历展开的游戏设计。

sessions.title: 'Seekers Notes': 5 Key Takeways from 5 Years Experience

summary.en: Seekers Notes reflects on five years of operating a free-to-play hidden-object game.
summary.zh: 《Seekers Notes》回顾运营免费寻物游戏五年的经验。

sessions.title: 'Spiritfarer's' Journey: Crafting Tenderness
sessions.title_zh: 《Spiritfarer》的旅程：塑造温柔

summary.en: Spiritfarer's developers reflect on designing mechanics that communicate care and kindness. The retrospective also covers the production and outreach challenges of a small team shipping an ambitious game across seven platforms during the pandemic.
summary.zh: 《Spiritfarer》团队回顾如何让玩法机制传递关怀与善意，以及这种目标带来的设计难题；同时分享小团队在疫情期间完成七个平台发行与推广的经历。

sessions.title: 'Sunless Skies': A Narrative Postmortem
sessions.title_zh: 《Sunless Skies》叙事复盘

summary.en: Chris Gardiner uses development documents and examples from Sunless Skies to examine how a small team managed a large reactive narrative. Topics include maintaining tone, refining the pitching process and seeking focused expert consultations.
summary.zh: Chris Gardiner 以《Sunless Skies》的开发文档与实例，梳理小团队组织庞大互动叙事的方法，重点讨论统一叙事基调、改进创意提案流程，以及通过定向咨询补足专业知识。

sessions.title: 2021 Player Engagement Trends in Mobile (Presented by Vungle)

summary.en: A mobile-market session surveys player-engagement trends observed in 2021.
summary.zh: 移动市场分享梳理2021年观察到的玩家参与趋势。

sessions.title: 30 Minute Steam Page Makeovers

summary.en: Chris Zukowski offers practical examples of refreshing a game's Steam store page.
summary.zh: Chris Zukowski 通过实际案例，介绍如何改进游戏的 Steam 商店页。

sessions.title: 30 Puzzle Design Lessons From The World's Greatest Puzzle Communities
sessions.title_zh: 向优秀谜题社区学习的三十条谜题设计经验

summary.en: This talk draws construction methods and design vocabulary from puzzle communities beyond video games. Examples span escape rooms, puzzlehunts, crosswords and chess compositions to show how their practices can inform digital puzzle design.
summary.zh: 本讲从密室逃脱、解谜活动、填字、逻辑谜题与国际象棋排局等社区中提炼设计方法和术语，讨论如何将这些长期积累的经验用于电子游戏谜题。

sessions.title: A Recipe for Mixed Reality in 'Mario Kart Live'

summary.en: Mario Kart Live discusses combining physical remote-controlled karts with a Nintendo Switch racing experience.
summary.zh: 《马力欧卡丁车实况》分享将实体遥控赛车与 Switch 竞速体验结合的设计。

sessions.title: Accessibility Best Practices: Mobility Considerations
sessions.title_zh: 无障碍最佳实践：行动能力方面的考量

summary.en: Karen Stevens uses game examples and her experience with mobility limitations to examine accessible interaction. The session covers specialist input devices, in-game assistance and simplified controls.
summary.zh: Karen Stevens 结合自身行动受限的游戏体验与具体案例，讨论如何支持不同操作需求，涵盖无障碍专用设备、游戏内辅助与简化控制。

sessions.title: Advanced Graphics Summit: A Dynamic Skydome System: 'Ephemeris 2'
sessions.title_zh: 高级图形峰会：动态天空穹顶系统 Ephemeris 2

summary.en: The presentation explains the rendering techniques behind Ephemeris 2, including atmospheric scattering, astronomical motion and dynamically lit volumetric clouds. It also discusses the optimizations needed for real-time use, with a version of the system used in Stormland.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍 Ephemeris 2 天空系统中的大气散射、日月星辰模拟与动态光照体积云，并讨论将这些效果用于实时渲染所需的优化，以及《Stormland》采用的定制版本。

sessions.title: Advanced Graphics Summit: Boots on the Ground: The Terrain of 'Call of Duty'
sessions.title_zh: 高级图形峰会：脚踏实地——《使命召唤》的地形

summary.en: Treyarch describes its terrain authoring tools, GPU-based editing and procedural biome workflow. The talk also examines virtual-texture blending and the memory and performance constraints behind Black Ops Cold War's terrain rendering.
summary.zh: Treyarch 介绍用于《使命召唤》系列的地形工具、GPU 实时编辑和程序化生态区制作，并结合《黑色行动：冷战》讨论虚拟纹理混合及六十帧目标下的内存与性能取舍。

sessions.title: Advanced Graphics Summit: Lifting the Fog: Geometry & Lighting in 'Demon's Souls'
sessions.title_zh: 高级图形峰会：拨开迷雾——《恶魔之魂》的几何与光照

summary.en: Bluepoint examines engine changes made for the PS5 remake of Demon's Souls. The session covers compute-based tessellation, light-field probes used for illumination and sound propagation, and screen-space directional occlusion.
summary.zh: Bluepoint 以 PS5 版《恶魔之魂》为例，介绍引擎在几何与光照方面的更新，包括基于计算的曲面细分、同时服务于全局光照和声音传播的光场探针，以及屏幕空间方向性遮蔽。

sessions.title: Advanced Graphics Summit: Procedural Grass in 'Ghost of Tsushima'
sessions.title_zh: 高级图形峰会：《对马岛之魂》的程序化草地

summary.en: Sucker Punch explains how it generates and animates individual grass blades on the GPU. The talk connects memory and performance constraints with the visual task of making many separate blades read as a natural field.
summary.zh: Sucker Punch 介绍《对马岛之魂》在 GPU 上生成、渲染和驱动单根草叶的方法，并讨论如何在内存与性能限制内，让大量独立草叶形成自然的草原景观。

sessions.title: Advanced Graphics Summit: Shadows of Cold War: A Scalable Approach to Shadowing
sessions.title_zh: 高级图形峰会：冷战阴影——可伸缩的阴影方案

summary.en: This talk traces Black Ops Cold War's approach to scaling shadows across hardware generations. It compares ray-traced shadows with a dynamic-resolution shadow-map fallback designed around fixed memory and performance budgets.
summary.zh: 本讲拆解《黑色行动：冷战》跨硬件世代的阴影方案，介绍高端光线追踪阴影与动态分辨率阴影贴图的衔接，以及固定内存和性能预算下的分辨率分配。

sessions.title: Advocacy Microtalks

summary.en: Advocacy speakers present concise perspectives on issues affecting game developers and their communities.
summary.zh: 倡导方向讲者通过短讲，讨论影响游戏开发者及其社区的问题。

sessions.title: AI Action Planning on Assassin's Creed Odyssey and Immortals Fenyx Rising
sessions.title_zh: 《刺客信条：奥德赛》与《渡神纪》的 AI 行动规划

summary.en: The developers trace a move from scripted decisions to GOAP in Assassin's Creed Odyssey and the later application of those lessons to Immortals Fenyx Rising. The session examines planning challenges created by dynamic open worlds and player freedom.
summary.zh: 开发团队回顾《刺客信条：奥德赛》从脚本决策转向 GOAP 规划的过程，以及这些经验在《渡神纪》中的延续，讨论动态开放世界与玩家自由度给 NPC 行为带来的要求。

sessions.title: AI Summit: 'Death Stranding': An AI Postmortem

summary.en: Kojima Productions reflects on the AI challenges of building Death Stranding's unusual world.
summary.zh: 小岛工作室回顾构建《死亡搁浅》独特世界时的 AI 开发挑战。

youtube.title: 'Death Stranding': An AI Postmortem

sessions.title: AI Summit: Advanced Real-Time Hierarchical Task Networks: A New Approach
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：高级实时分层任务网络的新方法

summary.en: The session introduces ART-HTN as a response to unexpected changes and hostile actions in real-time games. It examines why frequent replanning can undermine long-term behavior and how the proposed architecture handles changing situations.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍面向实时游戏的 ART-HTN，讨论传统分层任务网络遇到意外变化或敌对行为时的应对问题，以及频繁重规划与保持长期行动意图之间的矛盾。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Automated Game Testing Using a Numeric Domain Independent AI Planner
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：使用数值型领域无关规划器实现游戏自动测试

summary.en: Rebellion presents an automated testing framework that combines numeric domain-independent planning with behavior trees to play games from beginning to end. Examples from shooters and Evil Genius 2 frame a discussion of system complexity and testing coverage.
summary.zh: Rebellion 介绍将数值型领域无关规划与行为树结合的自动测试框架，目标是让系统从头到尾游玩游戏，并通过射击游戏与《Evil Genius 2》案例讨论复杂度管理及测试范围。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Beyond Pre-training: Experiences of Applying Imitation Learning in Game AI
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：超越预训练——模仿学习在游戏 AI 中的应用经验

summary.en: NetEase examples explore imitation learning both as a direct training method and as support for reinforcement learning. The discussion also considers training different play styles and making learned agents behave more like human players.
summary.zh: 本讲结合网易游戏的尝试，介绍模仿学习如何直接训练 AI、辅助强化学习，以及如何用于多种行为风格和更接近人类的行动表现。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Branching Out: 'Watch Dogs Legion's' Architecture for Group AI Behaviours
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：拓展分支——《看门狗：军团》的群体 AI 行为架构

summary.en: Ubisoft Toronto presents the aLiVE Group Behaviour System used to author multi-character scenes in Watch Dogs: Legion. The talk examines how group roles and context inform reactions when players interrupt events such as inspections, protests and hostage situations.
summary.zh: 育碧多伦多介绍《看门狗：军团》的 aLiVE 群体行为系统，说明如何制作检查、抗议、挟持等多角色场景，并在玩家介入时结合群体情境与角色分工组织反应。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Driving Emotionally Expressive NPC Animations and Behaviors with a Designer Friendly Pipeline
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：用设计师友好的流程驱动富有情感的 NPC 动画与行为

summary.en: Square Enix's WONDER prototype connects emotion, mood, personality and affinity to character animation and decisions. The talk explains authoring controls, debugging tools and ways to tune that pipeline for a desired interaction experience.
summary.zh: 史克威尔艾尼克斯以 WONDER 原型介绍情绪、心境、性格与好恶如何影响角色动画和决策，并讨论设计师控制方式、调试工具及针对目标互动体验的调节方法。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Experimental AI Workshop
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：实验性 AI 工作坊

summary.en: A series of short presentations surveys experimental game AI from independent developers, researchers and studios. Projects cover procedural generation, unusual gameplay tasks, co-creative tools and the continuing development of AI Dungeon.
summary.zh: 本工作坊通过多位开发者与研究者的短讲，展示程序化生成、特殊玩法任务、人与 AI 协同创作工具，以及《AI Dungeon》后续开发等实验方向。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Intrigue and Betrayal: Diplomacy AI in 'Total War: Three Kingdoms'
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：权谋与背叛——《全面战争：三国》的外交 AI

summary.en: The developers review how they rebuilt and tuned diplomacy AI for a sandbox with more than forty factions. Technical implementation and game-design perspectives explain the relationship between shifting alliances, diplomatic exchanges and the player's experience.
summary.zh: 开发团队从技术实现与游戏设计两方面，回顾《全面战争：三国》外交 AI 的改造和调校，讨论如何组织四十多个派系间变化的联盟与外交互动，并兼顾玩家体验。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Making the Believable Horses of 'Red Dead Redemption II'
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：塑造《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》中可信的马匹

summary.en: This session considers the role of believable horses in Red Dead Redemption II. It frames the development challenge around horses as both transport and companions central to Arthur Morgan's relationship with the world.
summary.zh: 本讲围绕《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》的马匹展开，讨论如何回应玩家对可信坐骑的期待，以及马作为交通工具和陪伴角色对亚瑟冒险体验的意义。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Missions Played As Anyone in 'Watch Dogs: Legion'
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：《看门狗：军团》中任何人都能参与的任务

summary.en: The session examines how authored missions interact with Watch Dogs: Legion's recruitable population and social simulation. Recruitment, injury and other systemic changes create edge cases across story, revenge and recruitment mission loops.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍《看门狗：军团》如何让预设任务与可招募的程序化角色、社会模拟共同运作，讨论角色受伤或被招募等变化带来的边界情况，以及招募、复仇等任务如何进入核心循环。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Squad Coordination in 'Days Gone'

summary.en: Days Gone explains coordinating groups of AI characters during combat.
summary.zh: 《往日不再》介绍战斗中协调成组 AI 角色的方法。

youtube.title: Squad Coordination in 'Days Gone'

sessions.title: AI Summit: Steering, Formations, and a Trail of Blood: AI in 'Wolcen'
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：转向、队形与血迹——《Wolcen》的 AI

summary.en: This AI retrospective covers route generation shaped by aesthetics and player experience, contextual steering for obstacle avoidance, and a flexible formation system. Examples come from Wolcen: Lords of Mayhem and its Bloodtrail chronicle.
summary.zh: 本讲复盘《Wolcen: Lords of Mayhem》及 Bloodtrail 的 AI，介绍以观感与玩家体验选择路线的生成方式、情境转向避障，以及支持整齐行列的灵活队形系统。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Where The $@*&% Are Your Tests?!
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：你的测试到底在哪里？！

summary.en: The talk examines why AI unit tests can become costly to maintain and how automated tests can support development. It connects technical test design with the team habits and process changes needed to keep testing practical.
summary.zh: 本讲从 AI 单元测试维护成本高、交付压力下难以持续的问题出发，讨论如何设计有助于开发的自动测试，以及团队文化和流程需要怎样配合。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Your Buddy, the Grandmaster: Repurposing Gameplaying AI for Inclusivity
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：大师级伙伴——让对弈 AI 服务于包容性

summary.en: Batu Aytemiz explores using gameplaying AI to assist players rather than only oppose them. A design exercise and examples built around reinforcement-learning navigation illustrate ways to repurpose existing AI for player support.
summary.zh: Batu Aytemiz 探讨如何把原本与玩家对抗的游戏 AI 转用于辅助玩家，并通过设计练习和强化学习导航案例，说明既有 AI 系统可以支持哪些帮助方式。

sessions.title: AI x Game Environment Guardian
sessions.title_zh: AI 与游戏环境守护

summary.en: The presentation examines moderation systems for text, voice and player behavior, including ways to adapt to changing player expressions. It also outlines a public-opinion analysis pipeline for sentiment, emerging topics and community monitoring.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍覆盖文字、语音与玩家行为的游戏环境治理系统，讨论如何随玩家表达变化迭代检测方法；另以舆情分析流程说明情感分析、热点挖掘与社群监测的组织方式。

sessions.title: Animation Bootcamp: Cuphead Process and Philosophy
sessions.title_zh: 动画训练营：《Cuphead》的流程与创作理念

summary.en: A Cuphead artist discusses the design and animation process behind the hand-drawn game. The session shares practical working ideas and animation tips from that production perspective.
summary.zh: 《Cuphead》的美术创作者介绍这款手绘游戏的设计与动画制作流程，并从实际制作经验中分享可供动画师参考的方法与技巧。

sessions.title: Animation for VR

summary.en: VR animators examine working without a fixed camera and adapting animation conventions accordingly.
summary.zh: VR 动画分享探讨在没有固定摄影机的条件下，如何调整动画制作惯例。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: Animating a Complex 2D Fighting Game 3 Frames at a Time

summary.en: Treachery in Beatdown City discusses economical animation for its hybrid combat system.
summary.zh: 《Treachery in Beatdown City》分享混合战斗系统中的精简动画制作。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: Environmental and Motion Matched Interactions; 'Madden', 'FIFA' and Beyond!

summary.en: EA examines multi-character interaction systems and motion-matched interactions across sports games.
summary.zh: EA 介绍体育游戏中的多角色交互系统，以及动作匹配交互的应用。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: From Design: Full Procedural Animations for Mechs
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：从设计出发——机甲的全程序化动画

summary.en: This session describes an animation system that derives motion from the joint structures of interchangeable mech parts. It covers the implementation and lessons involved in supporting varied part combinations without requiring a common skeletal layout.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍根据机甲各部件关节结构生成动作的动画系统，讨论如何支持不同部件组合，以及摆脱统一骨架和共用动画资源限制时的实现经验。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: How to Make Animation Blend More Natural: A Mannequin-Based Multi-Fragment Animation Blend System
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：让混合更自然——基于 Mannequin 的多片段动画混合系统

summary.en: This session discusses animation blending that combines preliminary motion-path simulation with position correction and filtering. It considers how constraints and filters can refine blended output beyond a conventional tween function.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论将运动路径预模拟、位置修正与结果过滤结合的动画混合系统，介绍如何在传统补间混合之外，通过规则与约束进一步处理混合后的动作。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: Rebuilding the 'Borderlands' Animation Pipeline in Unreal 4
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：在 Unreal 4 中重建《无主之地》的动画流程

summary.en: Borderlands 3's animation and rigging teams reflect on rebuilding their pipeline during an engine transition. Topics include animation layering, procedural rigs, tools for weapon variation and collaboration with a newly involved sister studio.
summary.zh: 《无主之地 3》的动画与绑定团队回顾迁移 Unreal 4 时的流程重建，涵盖动作分层、程序化绑定、支持大量武器变化的工具，以及与新加入的姊妹工作室协作的挑战。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: Take 'CONTROL' of Animation

summary.en: Remedy recounts developing animation technology after losing access to its previous middleware.
summary.zh: Remedy 回顾原有中间件退出市场后，自行开发动画技术的经历。

youtube.title: Take 'Control' of Animation

sessions.title: Are You Venture Investible: Non-Obvious Roadblocks and Red Flags When Pitching Game VCs

summary.en: This funding session explores less obvious obstacles and warning signs in venture-capital pitches.
summary.zh: 本场融资分享探讨风险投资提案中不明显的障碍和风险信号。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: Better, Stronger, Faster: 3D Concept Art for Environment Production
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：更好、更强、更快——服务场景制作的三维概念设计

summary.en: Fatshark presents a 3D-heavy environment concept workflow that connects visual planning with level design and environment art. The session follows how these disciplines collaborate during production to align appearance and gameplay.
summary.zh: Fatshark 介绍以三维制作为核心的场景概念设计流程，讨论概念美术、关卡设计与场景美术如何衔接，让视觉方案与玩法需求在制作中共同推进。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: Collaborative Art Direction
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：协作式美术指导

summary.en: Two Insomniac art directors explain how they divided responsibilities on Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales. Character art, cinematics, VFX, color scripting and environment concepts provide examples of coordination and cultural representation decisions.
summary.zh: Insomniac 的两位美术总监以《漫威蜘蛛侠：迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯》说明分工与协作方式，涉及角色、过场、特效、色彩脚本与场景概念，也讨论文化呈现和 PS5 版本的视觉目标。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: Creating Narrative Context for Store Cosmetics
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：为商店外观建立叙事背景

summary.en: Spellbreak offers a case study in collaboration between narrative and art teams on purchasable cosmetics. The session examines how shared themes guide the creation of skins, items and visual effects.
summary.zh: 本讲以《Spellbreak》为例，介绍叙事与美术团队如何共同设计付费外观，将主题背景融入皮肤、道具和视觉特效的创作过程。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: IKEA: Art Directing the Real World
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：宜家——为现实世界进行美术指导

summary.en: IKEA follows a digital room set from the initial idea to its finished image. The presentation outlines its current 3D production process and discusses future uses of 3D visual communication.
summary.zh: 宜家以一组三维房间布景为线索，介绍从构思到最终图像的美术与制作流程，并分享其对未来三维视觉传播用途的设想。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: LIVE Fireside Chat with Jason Connell and Andrew Maximov
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：Jason Connell 与 Andrew Maximov 现场炉边谈话

summary.en: Jason Connell and Andrew Maximov discuss art direction through Ghost of Tsushima. Their conversation focuses on simplicity, color and lighting as creative choices in shaping the game's visual identity.
summary.zh: Jason Connell 与 Andrew Maximov 围绕《对马岛之魂》展开对谈，从简洁性、色彩和光照等角度讨论游戏的美术指导与视觉表达。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: LIVE Fireside Chat with John Sweeney and Andrew Maximov
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：John Sweeney 与 Andrew Maximov 现场炉边谈话

summary.en: John Sweeney discusses his creative approach to concept art and art direction. The conversation considers the roles of 2D and 3D work, collaboration with other artists and the value of subtle visual choices.
summary.zh: John Sweeney 分享概念设计和美术指导的创作思路，讨论二维与三维方法的分工、与其他美术成员的合作，以及细微视觉处理在整体方向中的作用。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: The Natural World of 'Assassin's Creed Valhalla'
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：《刺客信条：英灵殿》的自然世界

summary.en: The talk follows Assassin's Creed Valhalla's biomes from art direction and concept work to asset production and procedural tools. It examines the production choices and navigation challenges involved in building varied natural environments.
summary.zh: 本讲从美术指导出发，梳理《刺客信条：英灵殿》生态区从概念、资产到程序化工具的制作过程，并讨论自由探索对森林等自然场景提出的设计和生产要求。

sessions.title: Art vs. Production: The "Battle" to Ship Premium Cosmetics in 'VALORANT'

summary.en: VALORANT's cosmetics leads discuss balancing artistic ambitions with production when delivering premium weapon skins.
summary.zh: 《无畏契约》外观团队负责人分享交付高品质武器皮肤时，美术目标与制作的平衡。

sessions.title: Ask Me Anything: Brian Horton, Creative Director on Insomniac Games' Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales
sessions.title_zh: 有问必答：《漫威蜘蛛侠：迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯》创意总监 Brian Horton

summary.en: Brian Horton answers audience questions about the development of Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales. The discussion includes the game's guiding pillars, representation and diversity, and his own career path.
summary.zh: Brian Horton 围绕《漫威蜘蛛侠：迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯》的开发回答观众提问，话题包括核心创作支柱、多样性与群体呈现，以及他的职业经历。

sessions.title: Ask Me Anything: Q&A with 'Demon's Souls' Creative Director Gavin Moore
sessions.title_zh: 有问必答：《恶魔之魂》创意总监 Gavin Moore

summary.en: Gavin Moore discusses the PS5 remake of Demon's Souls in a live audience Q&A. Questions also address the responsibilities of a creative director and experiences from his career in games.
summary.zh: Gavin Moore 在现场问答中分享 PS5 版《恶魔之魂》的重制开发经历，并讨论创意总监的职责及其多年游戏从业经验。

sessions.title: Ask Me Anything: Q&A with Obsidian Entertainment's Carrie Patel
sessions.title_zh: 有问必答：Obsidian Entertainment 的 Carrie Patel

summary.en: Carrie Patel answers questions about narrative and game direction using her work on The Outer Worlds and Pillars of Eternity. The conversation draws on both base games and expansions, including Peril on Gorgon.
summary.zh: Carrie Patel 结合《天外世界》《永恒之柱》及相关扩展的工作经历，回答关于游戏导演和叙事设计的问题，涉及《戈耳工危机》等项目。

sessions.title: Ask Me Anything: Q&A with Yacht Club Games' David D'Angelo
sessions.title_zh: 有问必答：Yacht Club Games 的 David D'Angelo

summary.en: David D'Angelo discusses his work on Cyber Shadow and the Shovel Knight series in an audience Q&A. Topics extend from gameplay programming to business development and marketing.
summary.zh: David D'Angelo 在问答中分享《Cyber Shadow》与《铲子骑士》系列的开发经历，并围绕玩法编程、业务拓展和市场推广等话题交流经验。

sessions.title: Ask Me Anything: Sucker Punch Productions Co-founder Brian Fleming talks 'Ghost of Tsushima'

summary.en: Brian Fleming answers questions about Ghost of Tsushima's development in a live Showcase conversation.
summary.zh: Brian Fleming 在 Showcase 现场问答中分享《对马岛之魂》的开发经历。

sessions.title: Audio Futures: Technologies for Games

summary.en: Game-audio practitioners discuss intersections between realistic virtual-sound research and emerging production technology.
summary.zh: 游戏音频从业者讨论逼真虚拟声音研究与新兴制作技术之间的联系。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: 'Genesis Noir': Bringing Jazz Improvisation To Gaming

summary.en: Genesis Noir explores building interactive experiences around learning jazz and improvising together.
summary.zh: 《Genesis Noir》分享围绕爵士乐学习与即兴合奏构建交互体验的过程。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: Behind the Scenes of the Audio in 'Say No! More'

summary.en: Say No! More discusses its soundtrack's development, including expressive synthesis and compositional choices.
summary.zh: 《Say No! More》介绍配乐开发中的表现性合成器运用与作曲选择。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: DIY Musical Instruments Using Unity, Wwise and Game Controllers

summary.en: Audio specialists demonstrate building musical instruments with Unity, Wwise, and game-controller hardware.
summary.zh: 音频从业者演示利用 Unity、Wwise 和游戏控制器制作乐器。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: LIVE Fireside Chat with Anastasia Devana and Scott Selfon

summary.en: Anastasia Devana and Scott Selfon discuss audio across augmented, mixed, and virtual reality.
summary.zh: Anastasia Devana 与 Scott Selfon 对谈增强、混合及虚拟现实音频。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: Moving the Needle: Inclusive Audio Production Practices in 'Tell Me Why'
sessions.title_zh: 音频峰会：推动改变——《Tell Me Why》的包容性音频制作

summary.en: Tell Me Why provides a case study of inclusive audio production and collaboration across disciplines. The talk covers cultural and regional research, partnerships with community advocates, casting and localization decisions.
summary.zh: 本讲借《Tell Me Why》讨论音频制作中的包容性实践，涵盖文化与地域研究、与社群倡导者合作、配音选角和本地化，以及跨部门日常决策如何影响群体呈现。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: The Read Thread: Repetition and Variation in Game Music
sessions.title_zh: 音频峰会：贯穿始终的线索——游戏音乐中的重复与变化

summary.en: What The Golf composer Sune Kølster explores the balance between musical repetition and variation in interactive work. His discussion draws on film scoring, classical composition and punk alongside the game's musical design.
summary.zh: 《What The Golf》作曲者 Sune Kølster 结合游戏的互动音乐设计，讨论重复与变化的平衡，并分享电影配乐、古典作曲与朋克经验如何进入游戏音乐创作。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: Voice Games: Past, Present and Future
sessions.title_zh: 音频峰会：语音游戏的过去、现在与未来

summary.en: The session surveys voice-activated games and the influence of smart speakers on their development. It reviews genres and examples before discussing interaction design, implementation challenges and possible future directions.
summary.zh: 本讲回顾语音控制游戏的发展，以及智能音箱对这一形式的推动，结合类型与作品案例讨论语音交互设计、实现难点和未来方向。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: VR Audio Adaptation of Third Person Gameplay

summary.en: Hitman's VR adaptation discusses reusing existing audio through systemic changes and dynamic mixing.
summary.zh: 《杀手》VR 改编分享通过系统调整与动态混音复用现有音频的方法。

sessions.title: Avoid an Identity Crisis as a Technical Designer
sessions.title_zh: 避免技术设计师的身份困惑

summary.en: Experienced technical designers discuss the varied forms their role takes within AAA teams. The panel focuses on bridging game design and engineering, including how responsibilities change with a project's needs.
summary.zh: 多位资深技术设计师讨论这一岗位在 AAA 团队中的不同形态，说明如何连接游戏设计与工程实现，以及职责为何会随项目需求而变化。

sessions.title: Azure PlayFab Multiplayer Servers Quick Start (Presented by Microsoft)
sessions.title_zh: Azure PlayFab 多人服务器快速入门

summary.en: Using a Linux build of OpenArena, this introductory session demonstrates integrating the PlayFab Multiplayer Game Server SDK. It also walks through building a Docker container and deploying it to Azure PlayFab Multiplayer Servers.
summary.zh: 本入门讲座以 Linux 版《OpenArena》为例，演示接入 PlayFab 多人游戏服务器 SDK，并介绍 Docker 容器的构建、打包与 Azure 托管部署流程。

sessions.title: Being Black in Game Audio
sessions.title_zh: 作为游戏音频行业的黑人从业者

summary.en: Black game audio professionals discuss their careers and the barriers they have encountered in an underrepresented field. The panel also reflects on how the events of 2020 changed their professional and personal experiences.
summary.zh: 黑人游戏音频从业者分享职业经历与面临的障碍，讨论行业中的代表性不足，并回顾 2020 年的事件如何影响他们的工作和生活。

sessions.title: Better Live Game Releases with Persona Based Testing

summary.en: Persona-based testing is explored as a way to strengthen release checks for live games.
summary.zh: 讨论通过基于玩家画像的测试，强化在线游戏的发布检查。

sessions.title: Beyond Test Servers: How 'For Honor' Made Testing a Celebrated Player Experience

summary.en: For Honor reflects on involving players in test-server iteration and balancing decisions.
summary.zh: 《荣耀战魂》回顾让玩家参与测试服内容迭代与平衡调整的经验。

sessions.title: Big World, Small Team: Designing a Scalable Ambience System for 'Ghost of Tsushima'
sessions.title_zh: 大世界，小团队：为《对马岛之魂》设计可扩展的环境声系统

summary.en: Ghost of Tsushima's audio team describes an ambience system that responds to time, weather, region and other game parameters. The retrospective follows its technical development and iteration under the demands of a large world and a small team.
summary.zh: 《对马岛之魂》音频团队回顾自适应环境声系统的开发，介绍如何根据时间、天气、区域等参数组织声音，并讨论小团队面对庞大世界时的技术取舍与迭代经验。

sessions.title: Billions of Gamers. Thousands of Needs. Millions of Opportunities. (Presented by Intel Corporation)

summary.en: Intel discusses varied PC-player needs and opportunities revealed through its audience research.
summary.zh: Intel 分享受众研究所反映的多样化 PC 玩家需求及开发机会。

sessions.title: Black Games in Review: An Afro Future Flyby
tags: University of Miami, Higher Education Video Game Alliance
sessions.title_zh: 黑人游戏作品巡礼：飞越非洲未来

summary.en: This showcase surveys analog and digital games by creators of the African diaspora. Case studies across genres examine cultural influences and the variety of approaches represented in their work.
summary.zh: 本展示通过不同类型的实体与数字游戏，梳理非洲及其离散社群创作者的作品，讨论文化背景的呈现方式，以及这些开发者各具特色的设计实践。

sessions.title: Blasting Through Obstacles of Remote Game Development (Presented by Nasuni)
sessions.title_zh: 突破远程游戏开发的障碍

summary.en: Nasuni and AWS present a cloud-file approach to sharing game projects across distributed teams. The session discusses a global file system in the context of home working, office collaboration and development across time zones.
summary.zh: Nasuni 与 AWS 介绍面向分布式游戏团队的云文件共享方案，讨论全球文件系统如何用于居家与办公室协作，以及跨时区接力开发。

sessions.title: Blowing from the West: Simulating Wind in 'Ghost of Tsushima'

summary.en: Ghost of Tsushima describes coordinating multiple systems to create convincing, gameplay-relevant wind.
summary.zh: 《对马岛之魂》介绍如何协调多个系统，实现可信且具有玩法意义的风。

youtube.title: Blowing from the West: Simulating Wind in 'Ghost of Tsushima'

sessions.title: Board Game Design Summit: 'Return to Dark Tower': Designing Compelling Physical-Digital Connected Games
sessions.title_zh: 桌游设计峰会：《Return to Dark Tower》——设计有吸引力的实体与数字互联游戏

summary.en: Return to Dark Tower and Beasts of Balance frame a discussion of connected tabletop production. The talk examines the interaction of hardware, software, manufacturing, finances and design processes in managing project risk.
summary.zh: 本讲以《Return to Dark Tower》和《Beasts of Balance》为例，讨论实体与数字互联桌游的制作，涵盖软硬件衔接、制造流程、资金挑战，以及通过设计流程降低项目风险。

sessions.title: Board Game Design Summit: 'Root': A Usability Postmortem
sessions.title_zh: 桌游设计峰会：《Root》的易用性复盘

summary.en: Root's usability developer revisits mistakes and successes in rules, graphic design, components and user research. The session uses that experience to examine how players understand a complex tabletop game.
summary.zh: 《Root》的易用性开发者回顾规则撰写、图形与组件设计、用户研究中的得失，讨论如何帮助玩家理解复杂桌游，以及认知负担等因素如何影响学习体验。

sessions.title: Board Game Design Summit: Art Direction for Board Games: Creating Compelling and Effective Visual Designs
sessions.title_zh: 桌游设计峰会：桌游美术指导——创造有吸引力且有效的视觉设计

summary.en: This session connects tabletop visual style with practical issues such as affordances and cognitive load. It discusses how art direction can support a game's theme and usability, including for teams without a dedicated art director.
summary.zh: 本讲将桌游的风格与基调同可供性、认知负担等问题联系起来，讨论视觉设计如何支撑主题和操作理解，也为缺少专职美术总监的小团队提供思路。

sessions.title: Board Game Design Summit: Creating Immersion in Tabletop Games
sessions.title_zh: 桌游设计峰会：在桌面游戏中创造沉浸感

summary.en: Using Dungeons & Dragons fifth edition and contrasts with fourth edition, the talk examines how tabletop rules support or interrupt immersion. It develops design principles for games where players themselves manage the rules and state.
summary.zh: 本讲对照《龙与地下城》第五版与第四版，讨论由玩家执行规则、维护状态的桌游如何建立或打断沉浸感，并提炼可用于其他桌游类型的设计原则。

sessions.title: Board Game Design Summit: Creating Resonance with Thematic Design
sessions.title_zh: 桌游设计峰会：通过主题设计建立共鸣

summary.en: The session proposes a compact framework for examining why game themes resonate. It develops that framework into tools for refining themes and connecting them more closely to game mechanisms.
summary.zh: 本讲提出分析游戏主题共鸣的简明框架，并据此讨论如何调整主题、形成设计工具，以及让主题与机制建立更紧密的联系。

sessions.title: Board Game Design Summit: Don't Hate the Player: Designing Board Games for Divergent Play Experiences
sessions.title_zh: 桌游设计峰会：别责怪玩家——为不同游玩体验设计桌游

summary.en: Emma Larkins examines how designers' own play preferences can bias their work. Practical and philosophical categories of play provide a way to consider experiences ranging from social conflict to low-interaction planning.
summary.zh: Emma Larkins 讨论设计者个人偏好如何影响桌游创作，并通过对游玩体验的分类，帮助理解社交冲突、独立规划等不同乐趣来源，拓宽设计选择。

sessions.title: Board Game Design Summit: Making Sense of Digital Tools In Modern Board Games
sessions.title_zh: 桌游设计峰会：理解现代桌游中的数字工具

summary.en: This survey classifies the roles of digital tools in tabletop play, from teaching and bookkeeping to storytelling and calculation. Published examples and player and industry perspectives frame questions about design, costs and hybrid play experiences.
summary.zh: 本讲梳理数字工具在桌游教学、记录、叙事、计算等环节的作用，结合已发行作品及玩家和业内人士的看法，讨论混合桌游的设计、成本与体验问题。

sessions.title: Breaking Design Bottlenecks with Dialogue Stubbing
sessions.title_zh: 用对话占位稿打通设计瓶颈

summary.en: The talk explains how dialogue stubs can make conversations playable before polished writing is available. It covers useful information to include, the handoff to writers and the problems caused by vague or excessively detailed stubs.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍如何用对话占位稿让内容在正式文案完成前进入可推进状态，讨论应包含的信息、与编剧的交接，以及过于笼统或过度细化带来的问题。

sessions.title: Breaking Down International Borders: Confidently Managing Global Gaming Payments (Presented by Tipalti)

summary.en: This operations session examines automating payments across international gaming partners and contributors.
summary.zh: 本场运营分享讨论面向全球游戏合作方与参与者的支付自动化。

sessions.title: Breaking the Ankh: Deterministic Propagation Netcode in 'Spelunky 2'

summary.en: BlitWorks explains the deterministic propagation netcode implemented for Spelunky 2.
summary.zh: BlitWorks 介绍《洞穴探险2》的确定性传播式网络同步实现。

youtube.title: Breaking the Ankh: Deterministic Propagation Netcode in 'Spelunky 2'

sessions.title: Breaking the Silence: The Sound of 'Hardspace: Shipbreaker'
sessions.title_zh: 打破寂静：《Hardspace: Shipbreaker》的声音

summary.en: Blackbird Interactive explains the sound-transfer rules created for a game set partly in vacuum. The session follows those constraints into Wwise and Pure Data implementation and their role in shaping the game's soundscape.
summary.zh: Blackbird Interactive 介绍《Hardspace: Shipbreaker》如何从真空不能传声的前提出发制定声音传播规则，并说明这些限制怎样落实到 Wwise、Pure Data 和整体声景中。

sessions.title: Breathing Life into Greek Myth: The Dialogue of 'Hades'
sessions.title_zh: 让希腊神话鲜活起来：《Hades》的对白

summary.en: Greg Kasavin and Darren Korb discuss the collaboration behind Hades' large voiced script. Topics include character voice choices, recording and implementation, and the influence of Early Access on narrative development.
summary.zh: Greg Kasavin 与 Darren Korb 分享《Hades》大量对白的协作流程，涵盖神话角色的声音定位、录制、处理与实装，并回顾抢先体验开发对叙事工作的影响。

sessions.title: Bringing Allies to Life in the 'Last of Us Part II'
sessions.title_zh: 让《最后生还者 第二部》的同伴鲜活起来

summary.en: Naughty Dog uses exploration and combat scenes to explain its approach to believable NPC allies. The examples connect character performance, behavior systems and moment-to-moment player interaction.
summary.zh: Naughty Dog 结合博物馆探索、伙伴同行与战斗片段，介绍《最后生还者 第二部》同伴的表演和行为系统，讨论如何让 NPC 在即时互动中显得投入而可信。

sessions.title: Bringing Console Gaming to Mobile with Crash Bandicoot: On the Run! (Presented by Arm)
sessions.title_zh: 把主机游戏体验带到移动端：《Crash Bandicoot: On the Run!》

summary.en: Arm and King discuss rendering tools and scalable techniques used for Crash Bandicoot: On the Run! The session focuses on identifying bottlenecks and adapting an artistic target to a broad range of mobile hardware.
summary.zh: Arm 与 King 介绍《Crash Bandicoot: On the Run!》的渲染工具和可伸缩技术，讨论瓶颈处理及管线优化，说明如何面向多种移动硬件落实视觉目标。

sessions.title: Building Game Development Communities
sessions.title_zh: 建设游戏开发者社区

summary.en: Linn Sovig draws on initiatives and events in Norway's game industry to discuss community building. The session examines ways to encourage knowledge sharing, mutual support and recognition of individual achievements.
summary.zh: Linn Sovig 结合挪威游戏行业的活动与倡议，分享开发者社区建设经验，讨论如何促进知识共享、相互支持和对个人成果的认可，也回顾组织过程中的教训。

sessions.title: Building Pipelines to Find, Grow, and Retain Diverse Talent
tags: PlayStation Studios QA, Sony Interactive Entertainment

summary.en: Industry participants examine initiatives to find, develop, and retain diverse early-career talent.
summary.zh: 行业参与者探讨发现、培养并留住多元背景初中级人才的行动。

youtube.title: Building Pipelines to Find, Grow, and Retain Diverse Talent

sessions.title: Call Me on My Cell Phone: The VR UI of 'Dance Central'

summary.en: Dance Central discusses redesigning interfaces when moving from Kinect to Rift and Quest.
summary.zh: 《Dance Central》分享从 Kinect 转向 Rift、Quest 时的界面重设计。

sessions.title: Career Development Demystified: A Framework for Career Growth in Video Games

summary.en: A career framework uses clear performance expectations to support professional development in game teams.
summary.zh: 职业发展框架分享介绍通过明确绩效期望，支持游戏团队成员成长。

sessions.title: Case Study: How Minecraft Ported Realms to Azure (Presented by Microsoft)
sessions.title_zh: 案例研究：《Minecraft》如何将 Realms 迁移到 Azure

summary.en: Mojang describes moving Minecraft Realms from a custom infrastructure-as-a-service setup to managed Azure services. The case study focuses on the migration process and considerations for limiting disruption to players.
summary.zh: Mojang 回顾将《Minecraft》Realms 从自建基础设施方案迁移至 Azure 托管服务的过程，重点讨论技术栈迁移以及减少玩家所受影响的考量。

sessions.title: Census: The Systemic Backbone Behind Play As Anyone in 'Watch Dogs: Legion'
sessions.title_zh: Census：《看门狗：军团》“扮演任何人”背后的系统骨架

summary.en: This technical talk examines Census, which generates Watch Dogs: Legion's citizens, relationships and schedules. It covers consistency across assets, relational database performance and the tagging and data coordination needed to connect characters to gameplay.
summary.zh: 本讲拆解《看门狗：军团》的 Census 系统，介绍市民、社会关系与日程的生成，并讨论角色资产一致性、关系数据库性能，以及连接角色与玩法所需的标签和跨团队数据整合。

sessions.title: Character Technology of 'The Last of Us Part II'
companies: Naughty Dog LLC & Sony Interactive Entertainment
tags: Naughty Dog LLC & Sony Interactive Entertainment
sessions.title_zh: 《最后生还者 第二部》的角色技术

summary.en: Naughty Dog reviews the evolution of character tools during an iteration-heavy production. Character authoring, shaders, gore tools and optimization illustrate the challenges of changing a pipeline while supporting an artist-driven workflow.
summary.zh: Naughty Dog 回顾《最后生还者 第二部》角色工具的演进，结合角色制作、着色器、伤害表现工具与优化，讨论高频迭代项目中如何调整管线并支持美术主导的非破坏式工作流。

sessions.title: Charm Your Communities
sessions.title_zh: 让你的社区心生喜爱

summary.en: Using examples including Among Us and Boyfriend Dungeon, this talk explores memorable community moments. It considers how elevation, pride and connection can guide concrete engagement activities outside the game.
summary.zh: 本讲结合《Among Us》《Boyfriend Dungeon》等案例，讨论社区运营如何创造值得记住的时刻，并从惊喜、成就感与联结出发设计游戏之外的互动。

sessions.title: Classic Game Postmortem: 'Deus Ex'
sessions.title_zh: 经典游戏复盘：《Deus Ex》

summary.en: Warren Spector revisits the development of Deus Ex and reflects on lessons from directing the project. The retrospective offers a first-hand perspective on the creation of the 2000 immersive simulation game.
summary.zh: Warren Spector 回顾《Deus Ex》的开发与导演经历，分享这款沉浸式模拟游戏在创作过程中留下的经验和教训。

sessions.title: Classic Game Postmortem: 'Ms. Pac-Man'
sessions.title_zh: 经典游戏复盘：《Ms. Pac-Man》

summary.en: Steve Golson recounts the development history of Ms. Pac-Man. The retrospective follows its origins in General Computer's Crazy Otto enhancement kit and the path to its licensed arcade release.
summary.zh: Steve Golson 回顾《Ms. Pac-Man》的诞生过程，介绍它从 General Computer 的 Crazy Otto 街机增强套件走向授权发行的开发背景。

sessions.title: Classic Game Postmortem: 'Quake': The End of the Original Id
sessions.title_zh: 经典游戏复盘：《Quake》——最初的 id 团队走向终点

summary.en: John Romero recounts Quake's creation and the pressures surrounding its ambitious 3D and multiplayer goals. The talk connects the game's development journey with the breakup of id's original team.
summary.zh: John Romero 回顾《Quake》围绕三维技术与联网玩法展开的开发历程，讨论项目中的波折，以及这段经历与最初 id 团队分离之间的关系。

sessions.title: Classic Game Postmortem: 'Star Wars Galaxies'

summary.en: Star Wars Galaxies' creators reflect on the history and legacy of the early MMO.
summary.zh: 《星球大战：星系》创作者回顾这款早期 MMO 的历史与影响。

youtube.title: Classic Game Postmortem: 'Star Wars Galaxies'

sessions.title: Cloud Gaming: Where Are We Now, Where Are We Going?
sessions.title_zh: 云游戏：我们身在何处，又将走向何方？

summary.en: Adam Billyard reviews cloud gaming technology and business experiences from the preceding decade. Video, GPU, pixel and command streaming provide context for discussing economics, platform constraints and cloud-native development choices.
summary.zh: Adam Billyard 回顾云游戏的技术与商业历程，梳理视频、GPU、像素和命令流式传输等方式，并讨论平台、开发者与玩家面临的限制及云原生项目的选择。

sessions.title: Collaborate Smarter with Design and Product to Improve Your KPIs (Presented by PeopleFun)
sessions.title_zh: 让设计与产品更好协作，改善关键指标

summary.en: PeopleFun's product leaders discuss how product and design teams work together on strategy and development. The conversation examines KPI goals and the relationship between product changes and user acquisition.
summary.zh: PeopleFun 的产品负责人讨论设计与产品团队如何在策略和开发中协作，围绕关键指标设定目标，并探讨产品改进与用户获取之间的关系。

sessions.title: Collaborative Game Development with NVIDIA Omniverse (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: 通过 NVIDIA Omniverse 协作开发游戏

summary.en: NVIDIA introduces Omniverse connections between content tools, its Nucleus collaboration layer and asset-oriented applications. A second part demonstrates extending Kit-based tools through extensions, APIs and interface components.
summary.zh: NVIDIA 介绍 Omniverse 如何连接内容制作工具、通过 Nucleus 支持协作，并展示资产搜索等应用；后半部分讨论利用扩展系统、API 和界面组件构建自定义工具。

sessions.title: Community Management Summit: Accessible Community Management
sessions.title_zh: 社区管理峰会：无障碍社区管理

summary.en: Stacey Jenkins and Courtney Craven discuss practical ways to make social content accessible. The session connects content creation habits with accessibility and inclusion across a game's community.
summary.zh: Stacey Jenkins 与 Courtney Craven 分享社交媒体内容的无障碍制作方法，讨论如何把易于采用的实践融入社区管理，让不同需求的成员都能参与。

sessions.title: Community Management Summit: Expanding Single-Player Games to a Multiplayer Experience with Discord
sessions.title_zh: 社区管理峰会：借助 Discord 为单人游戏延展多人体验

summary.en: Schell Games' Adam Kuta discusses building shared experiences around single-player games through Discord. Case studies and templates connect player interaction, ongoing conversation and the value of community work within a studio.
summary.zh: Schell Games 的 Adam Kuta 通过案例与模板，介绍如何在 Discord 上围绕单人游戏组织共同活动，维持讨论与玩家联结，并向工作室说明社区运营的价值。

sessions.title: Community Management Summit: How to Support Multi-Language Communities
sessions.title_zh: 社区管理峰会：如何支持多语言社区

summary.en: The talk examines community support beyond translating an English social feed. Case studies focus on local and cultural context when helping players in different regions feel included and connected.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论多语言社区如何超越英文内容的直接翻译，通过案例说明本地文化与语境的重要性，以及如何让不同地区的玩家获得参与感和归属感。

sessions.title: Community Management Summit: The Draw of Social Structures in Online Games during a Pandemic
sessions.title_zh: 社区管理峰会：疫情期间在线游戏社交结构的吸引力

summary.en: Mars Ashton examines online communities in Final Fantasy XIV, Guild Wars and World of Warcraft during pandemic isolation. The discussion considers how their social structures relate to players' psychological needs and mental well-being.
summary.zh: Mars Ashton 以《最终幻想 XIV》《Guild Wars》《魔兽世界》的社区为例，讨论疫情隔离背景下在线游戏的社交结构，以及它们与玩家心理需求和情绪健康的关系。

sessions.title: Community Management Summit: The Ever Increasing Impact of Voice Chat in Games
sessions.title_zh: 社区管理峰会：游戏中不断扩大的语音聊天影响

summary.en: This session brings together research on voice chat and player experience. It examines links to enjoyment, belonging, retention and well-being, and considers what those questions mean for community management and business decisions.
summary.zh: 本讲汇集关于语音聊天与玩家体验的研究，讨论乐趣、参与感、留存及情绪健康等议题，并将这些问题联系到社区管理和商业决策。

sessions.title: Community Management Summit: Trust & Safety Is a Team Sport: A Deep Dive Into Cross Department Collaboration Strategies
sessions.title_zh: 社区管理峰会：信任与安全是团队协作——跨部门策略详解

summary.en: The talk treats trust and safety as a company-wide practice that extends beyond moderation. It presents methods for coordinating departments around disruptive behavior, community rules and the player experience.
summary.zh: 本讲将信任与安全视为跨公司的工作，介绍围绕破坏性行为、社区规则和玩家体验建立部门共识的方法，讨论如何组织超出内容审核范围的协作。

sessions.title: Community Safety: What Does It Mean?
sessions.title_zh: 社区安全意味着什么？

summary.en: This discussion considers how to define community safety and divide responsibility between services and their members. It examines a shared approach to maintaining safe, inclusive experiences as communities grow.
summary.zh: 本场讨论社区安全的定义，以及平台服务与成员各自应承担的责任，并探讨社区扩大时如何通过双方协作维持安全且包容的体验。

sessions.title: Composing for Chinese Instruments
sessions.title_zh: 为中国民族乐器作曲

summary.en: Ian Chen uses the score for Fantastic Creatures to introduce writing for Chinese traditional instruments. The session covers instrument families, orchestration within a Western symphonic setting, and recording and production tools.
summary.zh: Ian Chen 以《Fantastic Creatures》的配乐为例，介绍中国民族乐器的类别、写作与配器思路，讨论它们与西方交响编制的结合，以及录音制作工具。

sessions.title: Connecting Core Gameplay to Progression in Mobile Free to Play Games
sessions.title_zh: 连接免费手游的核心玩法与成长系统

summary.en: This talk examines how different progression structures fit different core gameplay loops in mobile free-to-play games. Market examples illustrate the design choices involved in recombining familiar systems and evolving genres.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论免费手游中成长结构与核心玩法的匹配，通过市场案例分析不同系统如何重新组合，以及这种选择怎样影响类型的演变。

sessions.title: Conquer Challenges No Matter Your Team Size (Presented by Perforce)
sessions.title_zh: 无论团队大小，都能应对挑战

summary.en: Katie Cole and a panel of developers discuss small teams' production challenges, including large files, growing asset libraries and network latency. The conversation examines how those teams manage repeated iteration with limited resources.
summary.zh: Katie Cole 与开发者圆桌讨论小团队面对的大型文件、资产增长和网络延迟问题，交流如何在资源有限时管理持续迭代与制作压力。

sessions.title: Create Amazing In-Game and Out-of-Game Experiences Faster (Presented by Contentstack)

summary.en: Contentstack discusses delivering connected experiences both inside and outside a game.
summary.zh: Contentstack 介绍如何在游戏内外交付相互连接的体验。

sessions.title: Creating a Horror Score on a Shoestring Budget
sessions.title_zh: 用有限预算创作恐怖配乐

summary.en: The session explores composition and orchestration choices for horror scores with small ensembles and limited budgets. Audio and score examples introduce aleatoric notation and extended techniques, alongside production planning and developer communication.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论紧预算下恐怖配乐的创作与配器，通过音频和乐谱实例介绍偶然性记谱、延伸演奏技巧及小编制的运用，并涉及制作规划和开发者沟通。

sessions.title: Creating a Portrait System Based on DNA for 'Crusader Kings III'
sessions.title_zh: 为《十字军之王 III》打造基于 DNA 的肖像系统

summary.en: Paradox explains a DNA-based portrait system designed for distinctive characters, inherited appearances and gameplay-driven changes. The talk examines the system's operation and lessons from building it with a small team.
summary.zh: Paradox 介绍《十字军之王 III》基于 DNA 的肖像系统，讨论大量角色的外观差异、后代继承与玩法变化响应，并回顾小团队制作中的设计考量和教训。

sessions.title: Creating a Sustainable Volunteer Game Development Community
sessions.title_zh: 建立可持续的志愿游戏开发社区

summary.en: Justin Chin describes organizing a charitable volunteer development group across several teams. The session focuses on creating value for volunteers, supporting their needs and sustaining participation.
summary.zh: Justin Chin 分享组织公益志愿游戏开发团队的经历，重点讨论如何为参与者创造价值、提供支持，以及维持多支团队的长期投入。

sessions.title: Creating Feudal Japan from Across the Pacific
sessions.title_zh: 跨越太平洋，重现封建时代的日本

summary.en: Sucker Punch reflects on creating Ghost of Tsushima while researching a culture outside the studio's own experience. The talk covers new-IP development, cultural experts' contributions and creative direction throughout production.
summary.zh: Sucker Punch 回顾《对马岛之魂》的新 IP 创作，讨论团队研究异文化、重现日本历史环境的挑战，以及文化专家意见和创意指导如何贯穿制作。

sessions.title: Creating Newstalgia for 'Crash Bandicoot 4': Modernizing a Classic IP

summary.en: Toys for Bob discusses modernizing Crash Bandicoot while retaining the appeal of a familiar series.
summary.zh: Toys for Bob 分享如何现代化《古惑狼》，同时保留熟悉系列的吸引力。

youtube.title: Creating Newstalgia for 'Crash Bandicoot 4': Modernizing a Classic IP

sessions.title: Creating the Soundscape of 'It Takes Two'
sessions.title_zh: 创造《双人成行》的声景

summary.en: Hazelight's sound designers discuss spatialization and mix clarity in split-screen audio. Selected soundscape examples then trace the inspiration, creative goals and technical approaches behind their production.
summary.zh: Hazelight 的声音设计师介绍《双人成行》分屏音频的空间定位与混音清晰度问题，再通过具体声景案例梳理灵感、创作目标和实现方法。

sessions.title: Creative and Experimental VFX in 'The Last of Us Part II'
sessions.title_zh: 《最后生还者 第二部》中的创意与实验性视觉特效

summary.en: This technical art talk examines three environmental effects: water-edge ripples, curling beach waves and depth of field for small particles. Shader and asset workflows provide context for balancing realistic appearance and performance.
summary.zh: 本技术美术讲座聚焦《最后生还者 第二部》的水边涟漪、海滩卷浪和小粒子景深，介绍着色器与特效资产的制作流程，以及视觉真实感与性能之间的考虑。

sessions.title: Cross Promotion: The Benefits of Collaborating with Other Developers
sessions.title_zh: 交叉推广：与其他开发者合作的益处

summary.en: Stray Fawn Studios shares collaborative marketing practices such as themed sales, bundles and shared tools. Its developer collectives and Discord experience frame a discussion of knowledge sharing and post-release promotion.
summary.zh: Stray Fawn Studios 分享主题促销、捆绑包、共享推广工具等合作经验，结合开发者联盟与 Discord 社群，讨论知识共享和发行后的交叉推广。

sessions.title: Cutting Apart The Diegetic Interface of 'Hardspace: Shipbreaker'

summary.en: Hardspace: Shipbreaker examines using interface design to connect gameplay with its fictional world.
summary.zh: 《迷走深空：碎舰师》探讨通过界面设计，连接玩法与虚构世界。

youtube.title: Cutting Apart The Diegetic Interface of 'Hardspace: Shipbreaker'

sessions.title: Dealing with Scope Change in 'Heat Signature' and 'Gunpoint'
sessions.title_zh: 应对《Heat Signature》与《Gunpoint》的范围变化

summary.en: Tom Francis compares the development paths of Heat Signature and Gunpoint to examine expanding project scope. The retrospective considers how time was spent on features and how to recognize difficult projects earlier.
summary.zh: Tom Francis 对照《Heat Signature》与《Gunpoint》的开发过程，分析项目范围膨胀、功能投入与最终价值之间的关系，并反思如何更早识别难以控制的项目。

sessions.title: Designing a Production Process
sessions.title_zh: 设计一套制作流程

summary.en: The talk applies design scrutiny and iteration to the processes used to plan and execute game development. It examines how teams can evaluate their working methods with the same care they give to gameplay.
summary.zh: 本讲将设计审视与迭代方法用于开发流程，讨论团队如何像打磨游戏体验一样，检查并改进工作规划和执行方式。

sessions.title: Designing for Healing: 'UnearthU'
sessions.title_zh: 为疗愈而设计：《UnearthU》

summary.en: UnearthU's design process connects a companion character's narrative journey with self-reflection and care activities. The talk examines how its aesthetics and structure address mental illness, disability, overwork and burnout.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍《UnearthU》如何结合陪伴角色的历程、持续展开的叙事与自我关怀活动，并讨论围绕精神困扰、残障、过劳及倦怠进行设计的思路。

sessions.title: Designing the Secret Game that Helped Win World War II

summary.en: Simon Parkin discusses designing and deploying a historical wartime simulation game.
summary.zh: Simon Parkin 介绍一款历史战争模拟游戏的设计与运用。

youtube.title: Designing the Secret Game that Helped Win World War II

sessions.title: Developing a UX Mindset on Fortnite
sessions.title_zh: 在《Fortnite》中建立用户体验思维

summary.en: This talk explains the UX strategy developed for Fortnite through an understanding of cognition, scientific methods and design thinking. It examines how those perspectives can guide a team's decisions and development process.
summary.zh: 本讲以《Fortnite》的 UX 策略为例，讨论如何结合对认知的理解、科学方法与设计思维，形成指导项目决策和开发流程的用户体验视角。

sessions.title: Developing Data Intensive Games with MongoDB Realm SDK for Unity (Presented by MongoDB)
sessions.title_zh: 使用 Unity 的 MongoDB Realm SDK 开发数据密集型游戏

summary.en: The session introduces Realm's .NET SDK for Unity and data replication through Realm Sync and MongoDB Atlas. It examines cross-platform game data work in relation to caching, servers and database maintenance.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍 Unity 使用 Realm .NET SDK 存储数据，并经 Realm Sync 与 MongoDB Atlas 同步的方式，讨论跨平台开发中的缓存、服务器和数据库维护问题。

sessions.title: Developing Ray Tracing Content on Mobile (Presented by Arm)
sessions.title_zh: 为移动设备开发光线追踪内容

summary.en: Arm, MediaTek and Tencent describe a software implementation and demonstration of Vulkan ray queries on mobile devices. The talk examines preparation for mobile ray-tracing content, including dynamic lighting and reflections.
summary.zh: Arm、联发科与腾讯介绍面向移动设备的 Vulkan 光线查询软件实现与演示，讨论动态光照、反射等内容的开发，以及为移动光线追踪生态所做的准备。

sessions.title: DevNote: Next Level Game Development with HP Technologies (Presented by HP Inc.)

summary.en: HP presents its game-development technology and discusses its focus on virtual reality.
summary.zh: HP 介绍游戏开发相关技术，以及对虚拟现实领域的关注。

sessions.title: DevNote: State of the Industry: The Secrets to Success (Presented by Xsolla)

summary.en: Xsolla discusses changing business conditions and approaches to success in the games industry.
summary.zh: Xsolla 探讨不断变化的游戏经营环境，以及实现成功的思路。

sessions.title: DevTools for Harnessing Ray Tracing in Games (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: 用于发挥游戏光线追踪能力的开发工具

summary.en: NVIDIA introduces development tools for analyzing and improving GPU use in games with DXR and Vulkan ray tracing. The session focuses on tool capabilities that help developers investigate rendering efficiency.
summary.zh: NVIDIA 介绍服务于 DXR 与 Vulkan 光线追踪的开发工具，围绕 GPU 利用与渲染效率，讨论开发者可以借助哪些分析功能检查游戏表现。

sessions.title: Diversity + Representation LatinX Gaming Industry Panel
sessions.title_zh: 多样性与群体呈现：拉丁裔游戏行业圆桌

summary.en: Industry leaders discuss minority experiences in technology and games. The panel addresses representation, inclusion, career progression and pay disparities.
summary.zh: 本圆桌围绕科技与游戏行业中的少数群体经历展开，讨论媒体呈现、包容性、职业发展及薪酬差距等问题。

sessions.title: Diversity and Inclusion Starter Kit
sessions.title_zh: 多样性与包容性入门工具包

summary.en: Avalanche Studios New York shares how it started and sustained a diversity and inclusion initiative. The talk examines staffing, time, cost and practical organization within a AAA studio connected to a local indie scene.
summary.zh: Avalanche Studios 纽约团队分享启动并维持多样性与包容性倡议的经历，讨论人员、时间、成本和组织方式，以及大型工作室与本地独立开发文化的联系。

sessions.title: Dream Daddies and Fearful Fathers: How Indies Can Cope with Being Terminally Online
sessions.title_zh: 《Dream Daddy》与焦虑的父亲们：独立开发者如何应对过度在线

summary.en: Leighton Gray reflects on the emotional strain of online attention following Dream Daddy's success. Her experience frames a discussion of maintaining a healthier relationship with the internet while working as an independent developer.
summary.zh: Leighton Gray 回顾《Dream Daddy》成功后网络关注带来的情绪压力，讨论独立开发者既需参与互联网、又要维护身心状态时，如何建立更健康的网络关系。

sessions.title: Driving Innovation: A New Vehicle Pipeline for 'The Last of Us: Part II'
sessions.title_zh: 驱动创新：《最后生还者 第二部》的新车辆制作流程

summary.en: Naughty Dog describes reworking vehicle production for detailed, varied environments. The session contrasts a texture-heavy baking workflow with a new approach designed around production scale, iteration and texture-memory limits.
summary.zh: Naughty Dog 介绍《最后生还者 第二部》车辆资产流程的调整，讨论传统烘焙与贴图分配的限制，以及如何围绕数量、细节变化、制作效率和纹理内存重新组织生产。

sessions.title: Educators Summit: A Three Course Meal in Graphics Programming Education

summary.en: Champlain College describes a sequence of courses for teaching graphics and shader programming.
summary.zh: Champlain College 介绍图形与着色器编程的系列课程设计。

sessions.title: Educators Summit: Approaching a Pedagogy of Game Writing

summary.en: An educator presents a framework for teaching game writing and narrative design.
summary.zh: 教育者分享游戏写作与叙事设计教学的课程框架。

youtube.title: Approaching a Pedagogy of Game Writing

sessions.title: Educators Summit: Introducing Beginners to 3D Level Design

summary.en: This teaching session examines introducing three-dimensional level design coherently to beginners.
summary.zh: 本场教学分享讨论如何向初学者系统地介绍三维关卡设计。

sessions.title: Educators Summit: Living the Dream or Surviving the Nightmare: Making Commercial Indie Games as a Professor
companies: University of Wisconsin-Stout School of Art & Design & Paverson Games
Kent State University at Tuscarawas & Pie For Breakfast Studios
tags: University of Wisconsin-Stout School of Art & Design & Paverson Games
Kent State University at Tuscarawas & Pie For Breakfast Studios

summary.en: An academic developer reflects on combining university work with commercial independent-game development.
summary.zh: 学者型开发者回顾兼顾高校工作与商业独立游戏开发的经历。

sessions.title: Educators Summit: Object Oriented Python Crash Course Using Houdini

summary.en: A Houdini-based course introduces object-oriented Python to students working toward technical-art competence.
summary.zh: 基于 Houdini 的课程分享介绍面向技术美术学习者的 Python 面向对象编程。

sessions.title: Educators Summit: Teaching Games with Games: 6 Lessons from Life Online
companies: Parsons The New School for Design
tags: Parsons The New School for Design
sessions.title_zh: 教育者峰会：用游戏教游戏——线上生活带来的六条经验

summary.en: Educators reflect on adapting game teaching to remote classrooms, including multi-camera setups, Tabletop Simulator and Roblox visits. The session considers which lessons remain useful in online, in-person and blended teaching.
summary.zh: 教育者回顾远程游戏教学中的多机位、Tabletop Simulator 和 Roblox 参访等尝试，讨论哪些经验可继续用于线上、线下及混合课堂。

sessions.title: Educators Summit: Why My Students Design Escape Rooms
sessions.title_zh: 教育者峰会：为什么我的学生要设计密室逃脱

summary.en: Sam Liberty explains how an escape-room unit teaches brainstorming, rapid prototyping and iteration. The talk outlines a multiweek course structure culminating in a live escape-room experience.
summary.zh: Sam Liberty 介绍如何用密室逃脱设计教授头脑风暴、快速原型与迭代，并说明怎样安排跨数周的教学单元，让学生最终交付可现场游玩的密室体验。

sessions.title: Elevate Your Game with Progressive Delivery (Presented by Bugsnag)
sessions.title_zh: 通过渐进式交付提升游戏开发

summary.en: Bugsnag discusses managing release risk through phased rollout, feature flags and experiments. Monitoring and stability metrics are presented as inputs to decisions throughout development and deployment.
summary.zh: Bugsnag 讨论分阶段发布、功能开关与实验如何用于管理版本风险，并介绍怎样以监测数据和稳定性指标支持从开发到部署的决策。

sessions.title: Emotional Systemic Facial of 'Last of Us Part II'
sessions.title_zh: 《最后生还者 第二部》的系统化情绪面部表现

summary.en: Naughty Dog's rigging, animation, dialogue and design contributors explain how systemic emotions enter gameplay. The discussion spans subtle narrative moments and melee combat, with attention to implementation and cross-disciplinary challenges.
summary.zh: Naughty Dog 从绑定、动画、对白与设计多个角度，介绍系统化情绪如何融入《最后生还者 第二部》的即时面部表现，覆盖细微叙事时刻与近战场景中的实现和协作问题。

sessions.title: Enhancement of Particle Simulation Using Screen Space Techniques in 'The Last of Us Part II'
sessions.title_zh: 用屏幕空间技术增强《最后生还者 第二部》的粒子模拟

summary.en: The talk explains effects that use screen-space information to simulate on static and moving surfaces. Mapping between world positions and character UVs supports examples involving snow, water drips and blood on different materials.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍《最后生还者 第二部》借助屏幕空间信息在静态及运动表面模拟特效的方法，并通过积雪、水滴和血迹案例，说明世界坐标与角色 UV 之间转换的用途。

sessions.title: Ensuring a Positive, Collaborative Team Culture
sessions.title_zh: 建立积极协作的团队文化

summary.en: Richard Carrillo examines team culture under production and schedule pressure. The talk organizes leadership priorities around the team, players, the game's vision, craft and ideas.
summary.zh: Richard Carrillo 讨论质量与进度压力下的团队文化，以团队、玩家、游戏愿景、专业技艺和创意五项重点，分析领导者如何持续支持成员贡献与相互信任。

sessions.title: Entertainment AR/VR: Design Challenges and Opportunities in Mobile AR: A 'Table Trenches' Retrospective

summary.en: Table Trenches reflects on design constraints and opportunities in mobile augmented reality.
summary.zh: 《Table Trenches》复盘移动增强现实中的设计约束与机会。

sessions.title: Entertainment VR/AR: 'Insurrection 1944' Mixed Reality Experience: Bringing Interactive Storytelling to a Museum's Audience
sessions.title_zh: 娱乐 VR/AR：《Insurrection 1944》——为博物馆观众带来互动叙事

summary.en: The creators of Insurrection 1944 discuss a HoloLens museum experience set in a former Resistance headquarters. Topics include onboarding new MR users, simple interactions, virtual characters and the constraints of a real historical site.
summary.zh: 《Insurrection 1944》团队分享在真实抵抗运动指挥部遗址中制作 HoloLens 博物馆体验的经历，讨论新用户引导、简明交互、虚拟角色与实体空间限制。

sessions.title: Entertainment VR/AR: Building an Expansive Star Wars World in Mobile VR
sessions.title_zh: 娱乐 VR/AR：在移动 VR 中构建广阔的星球大战世界

summary.en: ILMxLAB discusses technical art and performance work on Star Wars: Tales from the Galaxy's Edge. Unreal Engine optimizations and customizations frame the challenge of delivering a detailed world on mobile VR platforms.
summary.zh: ILMxLAB 介绍《星球大战：银河边缘传说》的技术美术与性能工作，讨论如何通过 Unreal Engine 优化和定制，将细节丰富的世界带到移动 VR 平台。

sessions.title: Entertainment VR/AR: LIVE Fireside Chat with Curtis Hickman and Dana Ware
sessions.title_zh: 娱乐 VR/AR：Curtis Hickman 与 Dana Ware 现场炉边谈话

summary.en: Former The VOID creative leaders discuss location-based VR entertainment. The conversation connects experience design, technology and the effects of COVID with possible directions for the industry.
summary.zh: The VOID 的前创意负责人围绕线下 VR 娱乐对谈，讨论体验设计、技术与疫情影响，并分享对行业未来方向的思考。

sessions.title: Entertainment VR/AR: Postmortem: 'Maroon' an Educational VR Experience
sessions.title_zh: 娱乐 VR/AR：《Maroon》教育 VR 体验复盘

summary.en: The Maroon team reviews designing and prototyping an interactive STEM learning platform under budget and workflow constraints. The talk considers classroom onboarding, safety and the distinct needs of students and teachers.
summary.zh: Maroon 团队回顾在预算与流程限制下制作 STEM 互动学习平台的经历，讨论学生与教师的不同需求、课堂引导和安全，以及与年轻学生共同迭代设计的经验。

sessions.title: Entertainment VR/AR: Risks and Opportunities Highlighted in Important Recent VR Cases
sessions.title_zh: 娱乐 VR/AR：近期重要 VR 案件揭示的风险与机会

summary.en: This presentation examines three legal cases relevant to VR and AR applications. It uses them to discuss criminal activity, copyright and trademark disputes, and ownership questions in XR projects.
summary.zh: 本讲通过三个与 VR、AR 应用相关的法律案件，讨论违法行为、版权与商标争议、知识产权归属等问题，以及这些案例对 XR 开发与使用的启示。

sessions.title: Environment Design as Visual Storytelling: Theory and Practice
sessions.title_zh: 将场景设计作为视觉叙事：理论与实践

summary.en: Miriam Bellard examines how environments communicate character and story through visual cues. GTA V DLC and real-world examples illustrate concepts including contrast, gestalt perception, behavioral traces, associations and metaphor.
summary.zh: Miriam Bellard 结合《GTA V》扩展内容与现实案例，讨论场景如何通过对比、格式塔知觉、行为痕迹、联想和隐喻传递角色与故事信息。

sessions.title: Esports Summit: Diversity & Inclusion in the Esports Industry
sessions.title_zh: 电竞峰会：电竞行业中的多样性与包容性

summary.en: The Esports Bar Association presents findings from its 2019 survey of minority experiences with discrimination. The session considers industry structures and possible actions to support inclusion.
summary.zh: 电竞律师协会介绍其 2019 年关于少数群体歧视经历的调查，讨论行业结构与性别呈现问题，以及业内参与者可以采取的包容性行动。

sessions.title: Esports Summit: Living on 1HP: Early Research into Health and Performance in Esports
sessions.title_zh: 电竞峰会：只剩一滴血——电竞健康与表现的早期研究

summary.en: Esports health practitioners survey research relevant to players and support staff. The panel also considers areas where teams, developers, researchers and competitors could coordinate future investigation.
summary.zh: 电竞健康领域从业者梳理与选手及支持人员有关的早期研究，并讨论俱乐部、开发者、研究者和参赛者之间可以如何协调后续研究。

sessions.title: Esports Summit: Race to Compete: Speedrunning and Esports
sessions.title_zh: 电竞峰会：竞速争胜——速通与电子竞技

summary.en: This talk examines the growth of speedrunning communities, events and tools. It considers developer support, competitive formats and marketing opportunities in comparison with established esports.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论速通社区、赛事与工具的发展，分析开发者如何支持速通，以及它在竞赛形式和推广机会方面与传统电竞的联系。

sessions.title: Everything You Need to Build a Modern Cross-Play Enabled Game (Presented by Epic Games - Unreal Engine)
sessions.title_zh: 构建现代跨平台联机游戏所需的一切

summary.en: Epic draws on Fortnite and Rocket League to discuss friendships and cross-play. The session examines cross-platform requirements and how Epic Online Services can support a game's social and multiplayer features.
summary.zh: Epic 结合《Fortnite》与《Rocket League》讨论玩家友谊和跨平台联机，介绍跨平台游戏的构建需求，以及 Epic Online Services 在社交与多人功能中的用途。

sessions.title: Evolving Animating with Unreal Engine (Presented by Epic Games - Unreal Engine)
sessions.title_zh: Unreal Engine 动画制作的演进

summary.en: The session demonstrates animation and rigging workflows inside Unreal Engine, including Control Rig and Sequencer. It focuses on authoring in context and iterating without repeatedly moving between software packages.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍 Unreal Engine 内的绑定与动画制作流程，包括 Control Rig 和 Sequencer，讨论在实际场景中创作和迭代的方式，以及减少多软件往返的工作安排。

sessions.title: Experimental Gameplay Workshop
sessions.title_zh: 实验性玩法工作坊

summary.en: Developers showcase unconventional prototypes from across the world in a rapid presentation format. The session explores new gameplay ideas and potential genres through demonstrations of experimental work.
summary.zh: 本工作坊以密集展示的形式呈现来自各地开发者的非常规原型，通过实验作品探索新的玩法思路与类型可能性。

sessions.title: Exploration in Ghost of Tsushima: Letting the Island Guide You
sessions.title_zh: 《对马岛之魂》的探索：让岛屿引导你

summary.en: The talk examines environmental and character cues that draw players toward discoveries in Ghost of Tsushima. It connects navigation methods with the experience of roaming a dangerous landscape as a lone samurai.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论《对马岛之魂》如何利用风、动物与人物等世界内线索引导探索，并说明这些方法怎样同时服务于内容发现和独行武士的游历体验。

sessions.title: Exploring Alternative Methods of Web Monetization Microtalks
sessions.title_zh: 探索替代性网页变现方法短讲

summary.en: Teams supported by the IGDA Foundation and Grant for the Web discuss prototypes for alternative monetization models. The panel examines their design and implementation processes alongside broader challenges in web game revenue.
summary.zh: IGDA Foundation 与 Grant for the Web 支持的团队分享替代性网页变现原型，讨论设计和实现过程，并分析网页游戏收益模式面临的问题与未来方向。

sessions.title: Exploring Hidden Stories in the World of 'XCOM 2'
sessions.title_zh: 探索《XCOM 2》世界中隐藏的故事

summary.en: Environment artist Justin Rodriguez explains how small stories were embedded in XCOM 2's levels. The talk follows the placement and construction of environmental details intended to complement players' emergent campaign narratives.
summary.zh: 场景美术 Justin Rodriguez 介绍如何在《XCOM 2》关卡中布置微型故事，讨论环境细节的制作与摆放，以及它们如何呼应玩家在战役中形成的涌现叙事。

sessions.title: F2P Ad Placement Takeaways From Analyzing 150 Creatives and 6 Billion Impressions (Presented by Vungle)
sessions.title_zh: 从一百五十组创意与六十亿次展示中提炼免费游戏广告位经验

summary.en: Vungle presents an analysis of mobile-game ad placements using impression data from its network. The session combines placement examples with discussion of monetization choices and the player experience.
summary.zh: Vungle 基于其广告网络的展示数据分析手游广告位，结合具体接入案例，讨论广告变现安排与玩家体验之间的取舍。

sessions.title: Fair Play Summit: Applying Methods from Other Domains to Identify Gamer Behaviors
sessions.title_zh: 公平游戏峰会：借鉴其他领域的方法识别玩家行为

summary.en: The talk maps incident-detection approaches from finance, government, intelligence and professional sport to game communities. It considers how methods from those fields can help identify behavior and understand its context.
summary.zh: 本讲借鉴金融、政府、情报与职业体育领域的事件识别方法，讨论如何将其对应到游戏中的行为问题，并补充理解事件所需的情境信息。

sessions.title: Fair Play Summit: Building Blocks For Policy Development
sessions.title_zh: 公平游戏峰会：社区政策制定的基础模块

summary.en: This session examines the research and listening involved in writing community guidelines. It draws on large-scale policy work to discuss boundaries, safety and room for community expression.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍社区准则制定前的调研与倾听，结合大规模政策实践讨论行为边界、安全需求，以及如何为社区表达保留空间。

sessions.title: Fair Play Summit: Creating Inclusive Content In the Metaverse and Beyond

summary.en: Developers discuss creating inclusive virtual spaces and content for increasingly social online worlds.
summary.zh: 开发者探讨如何为社交化的在线世界创作包容的虚拟空间与内容。

youtube.title: Creating Inclusive Content In the Metaverse and Beyond

sessions.title: Fair Play Summit: Evaluating Game Features for Disruptive and Positive Behavior
sessions.title_zh: 公平游戏峰会：评估游戏功能对破坏性与积极行为的影响

summary.en: Riot Games introduces tools for considering player behavior earlier in feature design. The session examines how existing systems may encourage friction or positive interaction and how teams can design for intended behaviors.
summary.zh: Riot Games 介绍在功能设计早期评估玩家行为的工具，讨论系统可能诱发的摩擦或积极互动，以及如何有意识地为目标行为进行设计。

sessions.title: Fair Play Summit: LIVE Fireside Chat: Getting Started with the Disruption and Harms in Gaming Framework
sessions.title_zh: 公平游戏峰会炉边谈话：游戏破坏与伤害框架入门

summary.en: This introductory conversation explains the Fair Play Alliance's Disruption and Harms in Gaming Framework. It highlights its organization, practical resources and ways developers can begin using it in design and related work.
summary.zh: 本入门对谈介绍 Fair Play Alliance 的游戏破坏与伤害框架，梳理其内容与实践资源，并讨论开发者如何将其用于设计及相关工作。

sessions.title: Fair Play Summit: LIVE Fireside Chat: The Disruption and Harms in Gaming Framework: Six Month Check-In
sessions.title_zh: 公平游戏峰会炉边谈话：游戏破坏与伤害框架半年回访

summary.en: Developers reflect on the first six months of the Fair Play Alliance's framework. The conversation examines uses, lessons, gaps and priorities for future support and improvement.
summary.zh: 本对谈回顾 Fair Play Alliance 框架发布半年来的使用情况，交流实践经验、待改进之处，以及后续支持行业所需的重点。

sessions.title: Fair Play Summit: Tackling Cheating In Gaming

summary.en: Industry practitioners examine the growing challenge of cheating and its effects on games.
summary.zh: 行业从业者讨论日益严峻的作弊问题及其对游戏的影响。

youtube.title: Tackling Cheating In Gaming

sessions.title: Fair Play Summit: Virtual Identities: Opportunities, Ethics and Risks
sessions.title_zh: 公平游戏峰会：虚拟身份的机会、伦理与风险

summary.en: The panel discusses technologies that let players alter appearance, voice and other aspects of virtual identity. It considers immersion and privacy alongside impersonation, cultural harm and the potential loss of diversity.
summary.zh: 本圆桌讨论玩家改变外观、声音等虚拟身份特征的技术，分析沉浸感与隐私选择，以及身份冒用、文化伤害和多样性流失等风险。

sessions.title: Fandom-Ready: Creating Fiction in the Age of Fan Consumption
sessions.title_zh: 为粉丝社群做好准备：粉丝消费时代的虚构创作

summary.en: Using Monster Prom as a starting point, the talk examines forms of fan engagement and the appeal of fictional worlds. Themes, tropes, relationships and belonging provide lenses for considering creative choices.
summary.zh: 本讲从《Monster Prom》出发，分析粉丝参与和消费的不同形式，并借助主题、常见母题、角色关系及归属感，讨论虚构作品吸引社群的创作因素。

sessions.title: Fighting with Data: Learnings from Building the Combat System in 'Assassin's Creed: Valhalla'
sessions.title_zh: 用数据战斗：《刺客信条：英灵殿》战斗系统开发经验

summary.en: The Valhalla fight team reviews extending an existing data-driven combat system for more varied enemies and dual-wield abilities. Tools and production lessons frame a discussion of maintaining data with code-like discipline.
summary.zh: 《刺客信条：英灵殿》战斗团队回顾如何扩展既有数据驱动系统，以承载更多敌人和双持能力，并讨论工具、可维护性及像管理代码一样管理战斗数据的方法。

sessions.title: Find the Right Match: AI Enhanced Matchmaking Practice in Netease Games
sessions.title_zh: 寻找合适对手：网易游戏的 AI 增强匹配实践

summary.en: NetEase examines matchmaking factors including skill, queue time, latency and losing streaks. The talk covers win and churn models, combinatorial assignment algorithms and its matchmaking service practice.
summary.zh: 网易介绍技能差距、等待时间、延迟和连败等匹配因素的建模，讨论胜负与流失模式、组合分配算法，以及匹配服务的实际应用。

sessions.title: Fizzy Brushstrokes: The Art of 'Knights and Bikes'
sessions.title_zh: 跃动的笔触：《Knights and Bikes》的美术

summary.en: Rex Crowle traces the influences and early development of Knights and Bikes' hand-painted art. The discussion considers how the world reflects its young protagonists' perceptions and imagination.
summary.zh: Rex Crowle 回顾《Knights and Bikes》手绘风格的灵感与早期开发，讨论如何让世界的视觉表现呼应两位年轻主角的观察和想象。

sessions.title: Force Multipliers: Longterm Design Careers for Non Leads
sessions.title_zh: 放大团队能力：非管理岗设计师的长期职业道路

summary.en: The talk explores design careers beyond becoming a people manager. It examines skill development, the space between senior and lead roles, and ways specialists can influence teams through technical or conceptual leadership.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论不以人员管理为目标的设计师职业路径，梳理资深与负责人岗位之间的能力差异，以及专业人才如何通过技术或思想影响团队。

sessions.title: Free to Play Summit: Building a 10 Year Game Economy
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：构建可持续十年的游戏经济

summary.en: Ethan Levy revisits early economy decisions in Legendary: Game of Heroes. Those lessons frame questions about designing power progression, currencies and content pipelines for long-lived free-to-play games.
summary.zh: Ethan Levy 回顾《Legendary: Game of Heroes》早期经济设计中的问题，围绕能力成长、货币和内容管线，讨论如何为长期运营预先规划基础结构。

sessions.title: Free to Play Summit: Diagnosing, Fixing and Preventing Issues in Free-to-Play Economies
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：诊断、修复与预防免费游戏经济问题

summary.en: This session examines economy health before launch, during live operation and after serious imbalance. It focuses on resource flows, reward relevance and the complications introduced by events, offers and new content.
summary.zh: 本讲从上线前、运营中和失衡后三个阶段讨论游戏经济，分析活动、优惠与新内容对资源流动、奖励价值和新手体验的影响，以及预防和修复思路。

sessions.title: Free to Play Summit: Game Dev Stories
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：游戏开发故事

summary.en: Short development case studies focus on specific design and production choices in live free-to-play games. This edition covers procedural content in Adventure Capitalist and low-cost user acquisition practices from KooApps.
summary.zh: 本场通过具体设计与制作案例分享免费游戏的运营开发经验，包括《Adventure Capitalist》的程序化内容，以及 KooApps 的低成本用户获取实践。

sessions.title: Free to Play Summit: Hill Climb Racing: A Decade-long Road to 1 Billion Installs
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：《Hill Climb Racing》通往十亿安装的十年道路

summary.en: Fingersoft reviews Hill Climb Racing's history and long-term operation. The talk also considers developing its sequel while continuing to maintain the original game.
summary.zh: Fingersoft 回顾《Hill Climb Racing》的发展和长期运营历程，并讨论开发续作时如何同时维护初代作品，以及由此积累的经验。

sessions.title: Free to Play Summit: How to Win Players' Hearts by Personalized Recommendations in the Game 'UNO!'
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：用个性化推荐赢得《UNO!》玩家的心

summary.en: NetEase's UX team discusses recommendations for game modes and item packs in UNO! The session examines player differences, regional deployment and A/B testing used to assess recommendation strategies.
summary.zh: 网易用户体验团队介绍《UNO!》模式与礼包推荐的实践，讨论不同玩家和地区的需求，以及如何通过 A/B 测试评估推荐策略。

sessions.title: Free to Play Summit: IDFA's Gone Away: Will Free-to-Play be Okay?
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：IDFA 淡出之后，免费游戏会怎样？

summary.en: Developers, publishers and advertising networks discuss the early effects of iOS 14.5 tracking choices. The panel considers adaptation in performance marketing and in-game advertising as personalized ad tracking declines.
summary.zh: 开发者、发行商与广告网络围绕 iOS 14.5 后的追踪选择变化交流，讨论精准营销和游戏内广告受到的影响，以及广告个性化减少后的适应方式。

sessions.title: Free to Play Summit: Ludo-Narrative Goldilocks
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：玩法与叙事的恰到好处

summary.en: The talk examines how storytelling fits the variable sessions, pacing and monetization structures of free-to-play games. Examples from puzzle, idle and narrative-led titles support a discussion of how much story serves each design.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论免费游戏的碎片化时段、进度节奏和变现结构如何与叙事配合，结合解谜、放置及故事主导作品，分析不同设计中故事内容的适当分量。

sessions.title: Free to Play Summit: Narrative Breadcrumbs: Guiding the Player Experience with Live Events
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：叙事面包屑——用运营活动引导玩家体验

summary.en: King uses Candy Crush Saga and Soda events to examine the integration of narrative into live operations. The talk focuses on story components and their intended role in emotional engagement and event progression.
summary.zh: King 以《Candy Crush Saga》和《Soda》的活动为例，讨论如何把叙事融入运营活动，以及故事元素怎样服务于情感投入和活动推进。

sessions.title: Free to Play Summit: Smart Speakers: An Overview of an up-and-Coming Category
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：智能音箱新兴品类概览

summary.en: This session surveys game development for smart-speaker platforms. It considers how voice interfaces, hardware and software changes create design opportunities while introducing platform-specific challenges.
summary.zh: 本讲概览智能音箱平台的游戏开发，讨论语音交互与软硬件发展带来的玩法机会，以及这一平台特有的设计和开发挑战。

sessions.title: Free to Play Summit: Supercharging Game Growth: Playtika's Secret Sauce
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：加速游戏增长——Playtika 的秘诀

summary.en: Playtika's Boost Platform lead discusses the work involved in growing and operating games at scale. The session draws on the company's experience supporting a portfolio of long-running mobile games.
summary.zh: Playtika 的 Boost Platform 负责人围绕游戏增长和大规模运营展开，结合其多款移动游戏的支持经验，讨论长期扩展所需的工作。

sessions.title: Free to Play Summit: The Game Designer's Notebook
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：游戏设计师的笔记本

summary.en: Short talks examine contemporary free-to-play design issues through Sky, narrative LiveOps and Archero. The session includes moving from AAA assumptions to free-to-play and analyzing specific gameplay and storytelling approaches.
summary.zh: 本场短讲通过《Sky》、叙事运营活动与《Archero》讨论免费游戏设计，涉及从 AAA 转向免费模式的挑战，以及具体玩法和故事组织方式的拆解。

sessions.title: Free to Play Summit: The Year in Mobile Free-to-Play Games
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：移动免费游戏年度回顾

summary.en: Dave Rohrl, Steve Meretzky and Juan Gril review developments in the mobile free-to-play market. The analysis considers longer-lived chart leaders, fewer emerging genres and the resulting challenges and openings for developers.
summary.zh: Dave Rohrl、Steve Meretzky 与 Juan Gril 回顾移动免费游戏市场的年度变化，讨论榜单头部作品长期占位、新类型减少等趋势，以及开发者面临的机会与难题。

sessions.title: Free to Play Summit: Turning Science into Magic
sessions.title_zh: 免费游戏峰会：把科学变成魔法

summary.en: The speakers examine player-focused development that combines qualitative and quantitative evidence. They discuss tools and frameworks for defining problems, exploring opportunities and learning from failed attempts.
summary.zh: 讲者介绍结合定性与定量证据理解休闲玩家的方法，分享用于界定问题、探索机会和从失败中学习的工具及团队框架。

sessions.title: From 'Spyder' to 'Sackboy: A Big Adventure' in Interactive Music

summary.en: Winifred Phillips compares interactive-music work across Spyder and Sackboy: A Big Adventure.
