summary.zh: Winifred Phillips 对比《Spyder》与《麻布仔大冒险》的互动音乐制作。

youtube.title: From 'Spyder' to 'Sackboy: A Big Adventure' in Interactive Music

sessions.title: From Live to Sunset: Automating Live-Ops and Game Services
sessions.title_zh: 从运营到收尾：自动化运营活动与游戏服务

summary.en: Ubisoft RedLynx reviews preparing Trials Rising for a gradual reduction in live support. The talk examines production planning and infrastructure automation intended to keep player-facing services running.
summary.zh: Ubisoft RedLynx 回顾《特技摩托：崛起》逐步减少运营支持的准备工作，讨论制作规划、服务与基础设施自动化，以及继续维持玩家使用体验的考虑。

sessions.title: From the Burden of Waterfalls to the Benefits of Bidding (Presented by Facebook)
sessions.title_zh: 从瀑布流的负担到竞价的益处

summary.en: Facebook Audience Network discusses moving app advertising from waterfall mediation to bidding. The session examines operational changes, revenue considerations and preparation for changes in iOS advertising identifiers.
summary.zh: Facebook Audience Network 介绍应用广告从瀑布流转向竞价的过程，讨论广告运营方式、收益考量，以及应对 iOS 广告标识变化的准备。

sessions.title: From West to East: A Small Adjustment in Artistic Style Has Achieved Great Success
sessions.title_zh: 从西方到东方：通过美术风格微调适应新市场

summary.en: NetEase's art director discusses adapting visual approaches for audiences with different cultural aesthetics. The session considers how experience with Western art can inform adjustments for the Chinese market.
summary.zh: 网易美术负责人讨论不同文化审美对游戏视觉接受度的影响，介绍如何基于西方美术经验调整技法与概念，以适应中国市场的创作需求。

sessions.title: FUMO Engine: Applying AI to Defeat Cheating in NetEase Games
sessions.title_zh: FUMO 引擎：在网易游戏中运用 AI 反作弊

summary.en: The talk presents FUMO's use of behavioral and other game signals for cheating detection. It examines supervised and unsupervised learning alongside iterative model updates intended to address changing cheat patterns.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍 FUMO 如何利用行为及多种游戏信号识别作弊，讨论监督学习、无监督学习的分工，以及面对作弊模式变化时的模型迭代机制。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: "You Want to Do What?" Non-Traditional Pathways to Game Development

summary.en: Developers discuss moving into game development from less conventional professional backgrounds.
summary.zh: 开发者分享从非传统职业背景转入游戏开发的经历。

youtube.title: "You Want to Do What?" Non-Traditional Pathways to Game Development

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: 2D Animation for Games: A Primer

summary.en: An introductory session surveys fundamental skills for two-dimensional character animation in games.
summary.zh: 入门分享介绍游戏二维角色动画的基础技能。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: Building Narrative Games with Yarn Spinner

summary.en: Yarn Spinner demonstrates balancing writers' needs with implementation when creating branching dialogue.
summary.zh: Yarn Spinner 分享分支对话制作中，如何平衡编剧需求与程序实现。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: Growing Your Code Library with Each New Project
sessions.title_zh: 游戏职业研讨：让每个新项目都扩充你的代码库

summary.en: This talk examines turning project scripts into reusable systems for tasks such as audio and dialogue. It discusses which components generalize well and how to adapt older code for future games.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论如何把音效、对话等常见功能整理为可复用系统，分析适合通用化的组件，以及怎样改造旧项目脚本以支持后续开发。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: How the Hell do You Make Money!?
sessions.title_zh: 游戏职业研讨：到底怎样才能赚到钱？！

summary.en: Independent developers discuss income and funding approaches beyond relying on a breakout game. Topics include platform deals, ports, new markets, grants, crowdfunding and bundles.
summary.zh: 独立开发者围绕收入与资金来源交流，讨论平台交易、移植、新市场、资助、众筹和捆绑包等方式，以及缺少热门作品时如何维持开发。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: Killer Portfolio or Portfolio Killer Part 1: Advice from Industry Artists

summary.en: Industry artists discuss portfolios and the challenges of entering an increasingly competitive profession.
summary.zh: 行业美术从业者讨论作品集，以及进入竞争日益激烈行业时的挑战。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: Let's make a PICO-8 Game in 30 Minutes!
sessions.title_zh: 游戏职业研讨：三十分钟制作一款 PICO-8 游戏

summary.en: A live prototype walkthrough introduces PICO-8's Lua scripting and deliberate constraints. The session follows a blank project to a small game and discusses exporting and sharing work for iteration.
summary.zh: 本讲从空白项目开始制作一个小型原型，介绍 PICO-8 的 Lua 脚本与限制设计，并说明如何通过导出和分享支持快速迭代。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: The Resilient Job Hunt: Addressing the "Well of Doubts"
sessions.title_zh: 游戏职业研讨：有韧性的求职——应对怀疑之井

summary.en: Developers share routes into the industry and ways to navigate discouraging job searches. The panel gives particular attention to international applicants, women and underrepresented groups, alongside discipline-specific advice.
summary.zh: 多位开发者分享入行经历和求职挫折中的应对方法，特别关注国际申请者、女性与代表性不足群体，并提供不同专业方向的求职建议。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Connected Worlds: Building Dynamic Storyworlds Using Network Theory

summary.en: Network theory is explored as a way to manage growing, interconnected narrative worlds.
summary.zh: 探讨利用网络理论，管理规模增长且相互关联的叙事世界。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Everything Means Something: The Creative and Destructive Potential of Themes

summary.en: Wintermoor's creators examine how themes shape a game's meaning and audience interpretation.
summary.zh: 《Wintermoor》创作者讨论主题如何影响游戏含义及受众解读。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Finding Character Voice With Your Voice

summary.en: Narrative writers explore using their own voices to discover a distinctive character voice.
summary.zh: 叙事编剧探讨通过自己的声音，寻找具有辨识度的角色声线。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: How to Restore Player's Real Inner World in the Virtual Game: Strategies to Satisfy Players' Various Emotional Demands

summary.en: NetEase's UX team discusses narrative strategies for responding to players' emotional needs.
summary.zh: 网易用户体验团队讨论回应玩家情感需求的叙事策略。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Playing Is Perceiving: How Games Shape (and Reflect) Your Worldview

summary.en: This narrative session examines how games can shape and reflect players' worldviews.
summary.zh: 本场叙事分享探讨游戏如何塑造并反映玩家的世界观。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Press Y to Cry: Generating Emotions in Videogame Narrative
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：按 Y 哭泣——在游戏叙事中激发情绪

summary.en: This session examines approaches to evoking a wider range of player emotions during gameplay. It asks how narrative, setting and characters can build connections beyond familiar fear and excitement.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论如何在游玩过程中调动更丰富的情绪，通过叙事、环境与角色建立联结，探索恐惧和刺激之外的喜爱、同情、信任等感受。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Punching Upwards: A Panel On Satire, Truthtelling, And How A Comedic Premise Goes From Idea To Playable
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：向上讽刺——从喜剧构想到可玩体验

summary.en: Moderated by Evan Narcisse, the panel examines satire and humor in games addressing social issues. Creators discuss how pointed comedic ideas develop into playable work.
summary.zh: Evan Narcisse 主持创作者圆桌，讨论游戏如何用讽刺与幽默触及种族、政治、性等议题，以及尖锐的喜剧构想如何转化为可玩的作品。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Storytelling Siblings: The Kindred Connection between Games and Theme Parks
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：叙事手足——游戏与主题公园的亲缘关系

summary.en: Themed-entertainment professionals compare games with theme parks and other destination experiences. The discussion explores shared storytelling history, distinctive constraints and opportunities for designers in interactive attractions.
summary.zh: 主题娱乐从业者比较游戏、主题公园与其他目的地体验，讨论双方借鉴的叙事历史、各自的限制，以及互动景点为游戏设计师带来的工作机会。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: The Narrative Innovation Showcase 2021
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：2021 叙事创新展示

summary.en: Four short talks examine experimental narrative projects through their creators' goals and development problems. Each presentation focuses on particular techniques and the strategies devised to address them.
summary.zh: 四场短讲从创作者目标与具体难题出发，介绍实验性叙事项目，拆解各自采用的技术和解决策略。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Turn Your Writers Into Programmers: Greyboxing Narrative with Story Languages
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：让编剧成为程序员——用故事语言搭建叙事灰盒

summary.en: Ryan North and Jon Manning discuss scripting systems that let writers prototype story logic. The talk examines a middle ground between high-level narrative planning and individual lines, enabling earlier runnable narrative work.
summary.zh: Ryan North 与 Jon Manning 介绍帮助编剧搭建故事逻辑的脚本系统，讨论如何在宏观叙事规划与逐句文案之间建立工作层，让可运行的叙事更早进入开发。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Voice AI For Game Developers: Optimizing the Narrative Process
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：面向开发者的语音 AI——优化叙事流程

summary.en: The session examines voice AI tools for on-demand dialogue in game production. It discusses uses ranging from pre-production character prototypes to finished voice content and updates, with attention to workflow and cost.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍游戏制作中按需生成对白的语音 AI 工具，讨论角色对白原型、成品语音和内容更新等用途，以及相应的流程和成本考量。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Why Would a Gamer Want to Be Of the Other Gender: Gender-Changing In Role-Playing Games
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：玩家为什么想更换性别——角色扮演游戏中的性别转换

summary.en: NetEase shares observations about players changing character gender in RPGs where combat abilities stay the same. The discussion explores motivations beyond skills and equipment and questions of avatar freedom.
summary.zh: 网易分享角色能力与装备规则不变时，玩家仍希望更换 RPG 角色性别的观察，讨论能力之外的动机，以及虚拟形象可以提供怎样的选择自由。

sessions.title: Game Plan: How Voodoo Succeeds With Data and Automation (Presented by MoPub)
sessions.title_zh: 游戏计划：Voodoo 如何运用数据与自动化

summary.en: Voodoo and MoPub discuss the use of reporting and automated tools in a publishing business. The session connects those tools to daily decisions, early growth and future planning.
summary.zh: Voodoo 与 MoPub 讨论发行业务中的报表和自动化工具，介绍它们如何用于日常决策、业务成长及后续规划。

sessions.title: Game VR/AR: 'Pixel Ripped': Using Affective Memory to Increase Immersion on VR Games
sessions.title_zh: 游戏 VR/AR：《Pixel Ripped》——用情感记忆增强 VR 沉浸感

summary.en: ARVORE examines childhood memories as a design resource in Pixel Ripped 1995. The talk follows their influence on game design, narrative, art and sound as players move between a game world and its surrounding reality.
summary.zh: ARVORE 以《Pixel Ripped 1995》讨论童年情感记忆的运用，介绍玩家穿梭于游戏内外世界的设定，如何与玩法、叙事、美术和声音共同塑造沉浸体验。

sessions.title: Game VR/AR: From Inception to Final Delivery: The Making of 'The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners'
sessions.title_zh: 游戏 VR/AR：从构想到交付——《行尸走肉：圣徒与罪人》的制作

summary.en: Skydance Interactive reviews three years of developing The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners. Production, design and technical perspectives examine a difficult start, project changes and lessons for ambitious VR work.
summary.zh: Skydance Interactive 从制作管理、设计与技术角度，回顾《行尸走肉：圣徒与罪人》三年的开发，讨论早期困难、过程中的波折，以及复杂 VR 项目的经验。

sessions.title: Game VR/AR: The Magic of Designing Levels...In VR
sessions.title_zh: 游戏 VR/AR：在 VR 中设计关卡的魔法

summary.en: Balthazar Auxietre discusses VR-native tools used to build Maskmaker's worlds. The session examines scale changes, spatial understanding, rapid iteration and collaboration, including lessons from remote development.
summary.zh: Balthazar Auxietre 介绍《Maskmaker》采用的 VR 原生关卡工具，讨论在模型与建筑尺度间切换、空间感知、快速迭代和协作，并回顾远程制作中的得失。

sessions.title: Games as Community Driven Care: A Case Study of Co-design for Aphasia
sessions.title_zh: 游戏作为社区主导的关怀：与失语症群体共同设计的案例

summary.en: A participatory design case brings people with aphasia, language therapists and game designers together on three hybrid games. The talk examines collaboration across communication barriers and principles informed by rehabilitation research.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍失语症参与者、语言治疗师与游戏设计师共同制作三款混合游戏的过程，讨论跨越沟通障碍的协作方法，以及康复研究与迭代形成的设计原则。

sessions.title: Gaming Is the Next Big Thing on CTV" (Presented by Adjust)
sessions.title_zh: 游戏是联网电视的下一片机会

summary.en: Adjust discusses gaming applications in the connected-TV advertising landscape. The session considers an expanding role for games on a platform often associated with streaming video ads.
summary.zh: Adjust 围绕联网电视广告生态中的游戏应用展开，讨论在通常以视频流媒体广告为主的场景里，游戏正在获得怎样的发展空间。

sessions.title: Gaming: Getting the Most out of Your DSP Partnerships (Presented by MOLOCO)
sessions.title_zh: 游戏业务：充分发挥 DSP 合作的价值

summary.en: MOLOCO discusses working with demand-side platform partners on game user acquisition. The session focuses on aligning partnerships with KPI targets, growth and acquisition efficiency.
summary.zh: MOLOCO 讨论游戏用户获取中的需求方平台合作，介绍如何围绕关键指标、规模增长和获客效率组织合作关系。

sessions.title: GDC Main Stage: The Developer's Impact

summary.en: A multipart Main Stage presentation explores the impact of game developers and their work.
summary.zh: 主舞台系列分享探讨游戏开发者及其作品产生的影响。

sessions.title: GDC Pitch Presents: How to pitch your GAME to publishers
sessions.title_zh: GDC Pitch：如何向发行商推介你的游戏

summary.en: Publishers discuss what they look for in a game pitch and its presentation deck. The panel covers appealing project signals and warning signs during the search for a publishing partner.
summary.zh: 多家发行商分享评估游戏提案的视角，讨论展示材料应包含的信息、值得关注的项目特点，以及寻找发行伙伴时可能触发疑虑的信号。

sessions.title: GDC Pitch Presents: How to pitch your STUDIO to VCs
sessions.title_zh: GDC Pitch：如何向风险投资机构推介工作室

summary.en: Investors explain how studios can present themselves to venture capital and angel investors. The discussion covers pitch-deck content, attractive business signals and concerns that can undermine a proposal.
summary.zh: 投资者介绍工作室面向风投与天使投资人的推介方式，讨论展示材料、吸引投资的业务特征，以及可能削弱提案的风险信号。

sessions.title: GDC Podcast Live! Hosted by Gamasutra feat. 'Spelunky' Dev Derek Yu
sessions.title_zh: GDC 播客现场：对话《Spelunky》开发者 Derek Yu

summary.en: Derek Yu joins Gamasutra's hosts to discuss roguelike design and following up Spelunky with a sequel. The conversation also considers contemporary independent game development.
summary.zh: Derek Yu 与 Gamasutra 主持人讨论 roguelike 设计、《Spelunky》续作的创作，以及当代独立游戏开发的经历。

sessions.title: GDC Podcast Live! Hosted by Gamasutra feat. Disco Elysium writer Justin Keenan
sessions.title_zh: GDC 播客现场：对话《极乐迪斯科》编剧 Justin Keenan

summary.en: Justin Keenan discusses writing and narrative design at ZA/UM. The conversation focuses on creating Disco Elysium's world and characters.
summary.zh: Justin Keenan 分享在 ZA/UM 的写作与叙事设计经历，围绕《极乐迪斯科》的世界和角色创作展开对谈。

sessions.title: GDC Podcast Live! Hosted by Gamasutra feat. Game Marketing Pro Chris Zukowski
sessions.title_zh: GDC 播客现场：对话游戏营销专家 Chris Zukowski

summary.en: Chris Zukowski discusses practical game marketing in a crowded marketplace. The conversation covers Steam sales and the ways players discover and shop for games.
summary.zh: Chris Zukowski 围绕竞争激烈市场中的游戏推广展开交流，讨论 Steam 销售，以及玩家发现和选购游戏的方式。

sessions.title: GDC Podcast Live! Hosted by Gamasutra feat. Mohawk Games
sessions.title_zh: GDC 播客现场：对话 Mohawk Games

summary.en: Leyla and Soren Johnson discuss studio culture, community growth and strategy design at Mohawk Games. Their work on Offworld Trading Company and Old World provides the conversation's background.
summary.zh: Leyla 与 Soren Johnson 结合 Mohawk Games 的经历，讨论工作室文化、玩家社区成长与策略游戏设计，涉及《Offworld Trading Company》和《Old World》。

sessions.title: GDC Podcast Live! Hosted by Gamasutra feat. Prof. Lindsay Grace
sessions.title_zh: GDC 播客现场：对话 Lindsay Grace 教授

summary.en: Lindsay Grace discusses the connections between games and academia. The conversation also addresses socially impactful games and Black developers' experiences.
summary.zh: Lindsay Grace 讨论游戏与学术领域的联系，并交流具有社会影响的游戏，以及黑人开发者的从业体验。

sessions.title: Genderf*ck 2077
sessions.title_zh: Genderf*ck 2077：重新思考角色性别定制

summary.en: The talk examines inclusive genital customization from a queer trans woman of color's perspective. It considers reorganizing existing character-creation tools and the consequences for developers, content creators and players.
summary.zh: 本讲从有色酷儿跨性别女性的视角讨论更包容的生殖器官定制，分析如何重新组织现有角色创建工具，以及这些选择对程序、美术、设计和玩家的影响。

sessions.title: Getting the Most Out of an Entry-Level Games Job
sessions.title_zh: 充分利用游戏行业的入门岗位

summary.en: Hannah MacLeod shares practical ways junior developers and interns can learn through entry-level work. Examples range from meeting notes to temporary voice recording across large, small and remote studios.
summary.zh: Hannah MacLeod 结合初级岗位经历，为新人和实习生介绍从日常工作中学习的方法，涉及会议记录、临时配音等任务，以及大型、小型和远程团队中的机会。

sessions.title: Google Maps, Not Greyboxes: Digital Location Scouting for 'Untitled Goose Game'
sessions.title_zh: 用 Google Maps 勘景：《Untitled Goose Game》的数字选址

summary.en: Jake uses his filmmaking background to explain location scouting for Untitled Goose Game. Street View and real-world spaces shape a level-design process balancing gameplay affordances, source locations and visual constraints.
summary.zh: Jake 结合电影制作背景，介绍《Untitled Goose Game》如何通过街景寻找真实地点，并在玩法需求、地点特征与美术限制之间拼合关卡空间。

sessions.title: Great Level Design is a Studio Wide Effort
sessions.title_zh: 出色的关卡设计需要整个工作室协作

summary.en: Dana Nightingale examines the studio-wide support behind Arkane's level design. The talk considers how level designers communicate needs and how coordination failures can limit a team's results.
summary.zh: Dana Nightingale 讨论 Arkane 关卡设计背后的全工作室协作，介绍关卡设计师如何表达需求，以及跨团队沟通中的障碍怎样影响设计落地。

sessions.title: Hitman: Building a Material Library to Texture the World of Assassination (Presented by Adobe)
sessions.title_zh: 《Hitman》：构建材质库，为暗杀世界制作纹理

summary.en: IO Interactive explains using Substance Designer and Painter to texture a large prop library. The session examines reusable base materials, consistency, outsourcing and room for artistic choices in production.
summary.zh: IO Interactive 介绍《Hitman》如何用 Substance Designer 与 Painter 为大量道具制作纹理，讨论基础材质复用、品质一致性、外包协作，以及创作自由的安排。

sessions.title: Honoring the Blade: Lethality and Combat Balance in 'Ghost of Tsushima'
sessions.title_zh: 尊重刀锋：《对马岛之魂》的致命感与战斗平衡

summary.en: Sucker Punch reviews attempts to translate a swift, lethal samurai fantasy into ordinary combat. The session combines design details with a data-driven approach to balancing encounters beyond assassinations and standoffs.
summary.zh: Sucker Punch 回顾如何将迅速致命的武士想象融入常规战斗，讨论暗杀与对峙之外的设计尝试，并介绍以数据支持《对马岛之魂》战斗平衡的方法。

sessions.title: How Arm is Advancing Android Gaming in the Cloud (Presented by Arm)
sessions.title_zh: Arm 如何推进云端 Android 游戏

summary.en: Arm surveys options for Android cloud-game delivery with differing levels of client involvement. Partner examples and Arm-native development environments frame a discussion of platform services and development choices.
summary.zh: Arm 梳理不同客户端参与程度的 Android 云游戏交付方案，结合合作伙伴案例，讨论 Arm 原生开发环境、平台服务及相应开发选择。

sessions.title: How Distance Has Shaped the Sound of Our Games
sessions.title_zh: 距离如何塑造游戏的声音

summary.en: Frontier's audio team explains managing large numbers of sound sources in dynamic sandbox worlds. Object-based mixing and contextual decisions provide alternatives to distance alone, with Planet Zoo obstruction and reverb as examples.
summary.zh: Frontier 音频团队讨论动态沙盒中大量声源的管理，介绍基于对象的混音，以及结合情境而非仅依赖距离的决策方式，并以《Planet Zoo》的遮挡和混响为例。

sessions.title: How Great Key Art Can Lead to Doubling Marketing Numbers
sessions.title_zh: 优秀主视觉如何影响营销数据

summary.en: Graffiti reviews changes to key art and Steam banners through campaign examples. The talk examines visual decisions, adaptation to multiple banner sizes and the metrics used to assess audience response.
summary.zh: Graffiti 结合主视觉和 Steam 横幅调整案例，讨论构图与素材选择、不同尺寸的适配，以及如何用访问和愿望单等指标观察受众反应。

sessions.title: How Netease Could Help When Building Your Studio (Presented by NetEase Games)
sessions.title_zh: 建设工作室时，网易能提供什么帮助

summary.en: NetEase introduces its roles as an incubator, developer and investor. Portfolio examples frame a discussion of support at different studio stages, investment principles and post-investment management.
summary.zh: 网易介绍其孵化、开发与投资业务，结合被投工作室案例，讨论不同发展阶段的支持方式，以及投资原则与投后管理思路。

sessions.title: How the Industry Can Change the "Games Are Bad" Narrative
sessions.title_zh: 行业如何改变“游戏有害”的叙事

summary.en: The talk examines the history of moral panic around games and the industry's response. It argues for research partnerships and data sharing as ways to improve public discussion of games' effects.
summary.zh: 本讲回顾围绕游戏的道德恐慌及行业应对，讨论研究合作与数据共享如何帮助公共讨论更充分地认识游戏影响。

sessions.title: How to Be a Better Animator (Presented by Autodesk)
sessions.title_zh: 如何成为更好的动画师

summary.en: Harvey Newman draws on his progression from junior animator to animation director to discuss skill and career development. Practical tool use, including Maya, sits alongside perseverance and ways to sustain the creative process.
summary.zh: Harvey Newman 结合从初级动画师到动画总监的经历，分享技能与职业发展建议，涵盖 Maya 等工具的使用，以及保持投入和创作韧性的方式。

sessions.title: How to Empower Your Inner CEO with Mindfulness and Meditation
sessions.title_zh: 用正念与冥想支持你的内在 CEO

summary.en: This interactive workshop introduces mindfulness exercises and meditation in the context of game-development leadership. Participants explore attention, decision-making and emotional regulation through practices intended for busy workdays.
summary.zh: 本互动工作坊在游戏开发管理情境中介绍正念与冥想练习，围绕注意力、决策和情绪调节，尝试适合忙碌工作日的实践方式。

sessions.title: Immersing with Music: Approaches to Musical Storytelling in 'Cyberpunk 2077'
sessions.title_zh: 以音乐沉浸：《赛博朋克 2077》的音乐叙事方法

summary.en: CD Projekt Red's composers discuss scoring an open-world RPG with branching stories. The session focuses on creative musical approaches used to support Cyberpunk 2077's narrative experience.
summary.zh: CD Projekt Red 的作曲者分享《赛博朋克 2077》的配乐思路，讨论面对开放世界与分支故事时，如何通过音乐支持叙事体验。

sessions.title: Improve your Mobile Game's Experience with Lenovo (Presented by Unity)
sessions.title_zh: 借助联想提升手游体验

summary.en: Lenovo introduces the Legion phone and LegionSDK in a Unity-focused session. The talk examines device-linked immersive features and ways developers can reach mobile gaming audiences.
summary.zh: 联想在面向 Unity 开发者的讲座中介绍 Legion 手机与 LegionSDK，讨论设备相关的沉浸功能，以及面向移动游戏受众拓展触达的方式。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: 'Club Picocho': Developing Small Games As an Inexperienced Community

summary.en: Club Picocho reflects on building small games as an inexperienced community during the pandemic.
summary.zh: Club Picocho 回顾疫情期间，由经验不足的社区共同制作小游戏的过程。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: 'Monster Train' Postmortem

summary.en: Monster Train traces its development from early prototyping through the deck-building game's production.
summary.zh: 《怪物火车》回顾从早期原型到卡牌构筑游戏制作的开发过程。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Accessibility on a Shoestring

summary.en: Independent developers examine making accessibility improvements with limited budgets and resources.
summary.zh: 独立开发者讨论如何在预算与资源有限的条件下改善无障碍体验。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Contract Killers: What Developers Should Eliminate From Their Publishing Agreement

summary.en: A publishing-contract session examines agreement terms that independent developers should scrutinize.
summary.zh: 发行合同分享讨论独立开发者需要仔细审视的协议条款。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Cookin' and Servin': Making a Delicious Trilogy of Games

summary.en: David Galindo reflects on creating a trilogy and developing its third game's reception.
summary.zh: David Galindo 回顾创作游戏三部曲，以及打造第三部作品的经验。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Crafting a Magic Circle Around Your Production Process
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：为制作流程构筑魔法圈

summary.en: Sarah Scialli explores applying playful design methods to production itself. Examples connect paper prototypes, dialogue testing, design pillars and task tracking with collaboration across disciplines.
summary.zh: Sarah Scialli 讨论如何把游戏设计方法用于制作流程，将纸面原型、对白测试、设计支柱和任务追踪转化为协作工具，让不同专业共同维持创作愿景。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Crafting A Tiny Open World: 'A Short Hike' Postmortem
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：构筑微型开放世界——《A Short Hike》复盘

summary.en: Adam Robinson-Yu explains the scope, art, level design and writing choices behind A Short Hike's initial four-month production. The talk also considers release planning and setting player expectations before play begins.
summary.zh: Adam Robinson-Yu 回顾《A Short Hike》初版四个月开发中的范围控制、美术、关卡与写作选择，并讨论发行和游玩前的预期管理。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Demystifying Indie Publishing Offers
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：看懂独立游戏发行报价

summary.en: The talk walks through an indie publishing term sheet using real examples. It examines IP ownership, revenue sharing, recoupment, milestones and provisions for projects that encounter difficulties.
summary.zh: 本讲通过真实示例拆解独立游戏发行条款清单，讨论知识产权、收入分成、成本回收、里程碑，以及项目出现问题时的安排。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Don't Be a Copycat: Personalized Marketing for Your Game
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：别盲目模仿——为游戏量身规划营销

summary.en: A trailer and marketing specialist examines the purpose of websites, press kits and different trailer formats. The talk focuses on selecting assets that fit a game's goals and budget.
summary.zh: 预告片与营销从业者分析网站、媒体资料包和不同预告片的用途，讨论如何根据游戏目标与预算选择推广素材，并明确每种素材应完成的任务。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Failure Workshop 2021
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：2021 失败工作坊

summary.en: Ty Taylor and Nick Yonge share difficult experiences in independent development. Their accounts address early spending before gameplay was established and the personal and career effects of post-release depression.
summary.zh: Ty Taylor 与 Nick Yonge 分享独立开发中的挫折，分别涉及玩法尚未确定时的前期支出，以及发行后抑郁对个人状态和职业道路的影响。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Ghost in the Machine: Authorial Voice in System Design, 'Frostpunk' & Beyond

summary.en: Frostpunk's designers explore how game systems can communicate an author's perspective.
summary.zh: 《冰汽时代》设计师探讨游戏系统如何传达创作者的立场与表达。

youtube.title: Ghost in the Machine: Authorial Voice in System Design, 'Frostpunk' & Beyond

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: How to Navigate the Fringes
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：如何行走于创作边缘

summary.en: Chad Toprak connects experimental game-making with curation through Freeplay, Contours and Hovergarden. The talk considers lessons in organizing fringe work, with inclusion and care as guiding values.
summary.zh: Chad Toprak 结合 Freeplay、Contours 和 Hovergarden 的经历，讨论实验游戏创作与策展的交汇，以及包容和关怀如何进入边缘创作的组织实践。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Inclusive Marketing for Indies
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：面向独立团队的包容性营销

summary.en: Melissa Chaplin introduces intersectionality and inclusion within indie game communication. Practical examples across community, content and messaging show how teams can embed those ideas in daily marketing.
summary.zh: Melissa Chaplin 将交叉性与包容性概念联系到独立游戏传播，通过社区、内容与沟通三个方面的实例，讨论如何融入日常营销实践。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Indie SoapBox
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：独立开发者自由讲坛

summary.en: The 2021 Indie Soapbox brings multiple independent creators together in a virtual session. Its announced speakers include Tim Rogers, Nathalie Lawhead, Sarah Scialli and Latoya Peterson.
summary.zh: 2021 年独立开发者自由讲坛以线上形式汇集多位创作者，公布的讲者包括 Tim Rogers、Nathalie Lawhead、Sarah Scialli 和 Latoya Peterson 等。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Launch Day: The Emotional Cost Of Releasing a Game
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：发行日——发布游戏的情绪代价

summary.en: This session examines the emotional demands of releasing an independent game. It discusses feedback, expectations and ways to support developers through launch and the difficult period that can follow.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论独立游戏发行的情绪压力，分析反馈、外部期待与发售后低落期，并探讨怎样改善开发周期中的沟通和团队支持。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Making Room
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：为更多人留出空间

summary.en: Making Room presents practical approaches to diversity in indie development. Contributions address community access, hiring, storytelling and limiting assumptions about Indigenous media.
summary.zh: 本场以具体实践讨论独立开发中的多样性，涉及社区参与、招聘、故事创作，以及对原住民媒介形式的既定想象如何限制创作者。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: One More Run: The Making of 'Spelunky 2'

summary.en: Derek Yu reflects on creating a sequel to Spelunky amid a flourishing roguelike genre.
summary.zh: Derek Yu 回顾在 Roguelike 类型蓬勃发展时期，制作《洞穴探险》续作的经历。

youtube.title: One More Run: The Making of 'Spelunky 2'

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Regional Distribution Deals: In the Era of Online Events
companies: The Moonwalls & Academy of Art in Szczecin
tags: The Moonwalls & Academy of Art in Szczecin
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：线上活动时代的区域发行协议

summary.en: Marcin Makaj discusses finding regional distribution partners through digital events. The session examines how negotiation tactics and meeting preparation change when business development moves online.
summary.zh: Marcin Makaj 讨论通过线上活动寻找区域发行伙伴的方法，分析商务拓展转到数字场景后，谈判策略与会面准备需要怎样调整。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Sharing in Success: How to Compensate Your Team Through Revenue Sharing
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：共享成功——通过收入分成回报团队

summary.en: The presentation compares two common studio revenue-sharing structures and their trade-offs. It examines how shares are earned and calculated, how future DLC is handled and which implementation problems to anticipate.
summary.zh: 本讲比较两种常见的工作室收入分成结构，讨论分成的取得和计算、后续 DLC 的处理，以及制定团队报酬方案时需要预见的问题。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Sparking Curiosity-Driven Exploration Through Narrative in 'Outer Wilds'
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：用《Outer Wilds》的叙事激发好奇心探索

summary.en: The talk examines narrative choices that support player-directed exploration in Outer Wilds. It focuses on how a nonlinear story in a changing, time-looped solar system invites curiosity without relying on assigned missions.
summary.zh: 本讲分析《Outer Wilds》如何通过叙事支持玩家自主探索，讨论时间循环太阳系中的非线性故事怎样提供好奇心线索，而不依赖明确任务指派。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Spreadsheet Smarter Not Harder
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：更聪明地使用电子表格

summary.en: Tyler Coleman surveys spreadsheet uses across game-development disciplines, including design, art, marketing and community work. The session offers organization tips and reusable templates for development workflows.
summary.zh: Tyler Coleman 介绍电子表格在设计、美术、营销和社区工作中的用途，分享数据组织方法及可融入开发流程的模板。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: The Cultural Impact of 'Hundred Days': A Winemaking Simulator
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：酿酒模拟器《Hundred Days》的文化影响

summary.en: The developers and winemakers behind Hundred Days review translating a winemaking tradition into a management game. The retrospective follows its move from autobiography to fiction and examines cultural questions and design lessons.
summary.zh: 《Hundred Days》的开发者与酿酒者回顾如何将酿酒传统转化为经营游戏，讨论从自传构想到虚构版本的变化，以及文化争议和设计过程中的得失。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: What to Expect With Your Launch? Sharing Concrete Data on Various Marketing Activities When Releasing Your Indie Game
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：发行时可以期待什么——独立游戏营销活动数据分享

summary.en: Chris Zukowski uses data from recent indie releases to examine marketing expectations. Steam page response, streamer coverage and virtual festivals provide concrete situations for comparing outcomes.
summary.zh: Chris Zukowski 结合近期独立游戏的实际数据，讨论如何判断发行营销的合理预期，涵盖 Steam 页面反馈、主播报道与线上游戏节等情境。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: You Have to Stop Working, Even When You Can't Stop Working
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：即使无法停下，也要停止工作

summary.en: Independent developers share experiences of taking leave despite pressure to keep working. These short talks consider the mental preparation needed for time away and more sustainable development habits.
summary.zh: 多位独立开发者分享在持续工作压力下安排休假的经历，通过短讲讨论离开工作所需的心理准备，以及更可持续的开发习惯。

sessions.title: International Partnerships: Success in U.S & China Collaborations
sessions.title_zh: 国际合作：中美协作如何开展

summary.en: This talk examines the business, team structures and communication styles involved in U.S.–China game projects. It considers how partners can recognize cultural differences and build a coherent working relationship.
summary.zh: 本讲围绕中美游戏项目的业务模式、团队结构和沟通风格展开，讨论如何认识文化差异，并建立协调一致的合作方式。

sessions.title: Intrinsically Motivated Teams: The Science of Motivation
sessions.title_zh: 内在驱动的团队：动机的科学

summary.en: Alexandre Moufarek applies self-determination theory to game-development teams. The discussion focuses on competence, autonomy and relatedness as conditions for intrinsic motivation and sustainable work.
summary.zh: Alexandre Moufarek 将自我决定理论用于游戏团队，围绕胜任感、自主性和联结感，讨论支持内在动机与持续投入的工作条件。

sessions.title: Is there a AAA future for Mobile Gaming? (Presented by Imagination Technologies)
sessions.title_zh: 移动游戏是否拥有 AAA 未来？

summary.en: Artists and engineers discuss what AAA means for mobile games, from budgets and visuals to player experience. The panel connects hardware developments such as ray tracing with the creative and technical work of mobile production.
summary.zh: 美术与工程领域嘉宾讨论移动游戏中的 AAA 含义，从预算、视觉到玩家体验审视这一概念，并联系光线追踪等硬件发展分析制作需求。

sessions.title: Keep Players Busy When They Died: Death System Design in 'Conqueror's Blade'
sessions.title_zh: 让死亡后的玩家继续参与：《战意》的死亡系统设计

summary.en: Conqueror's Blade: Frontier provides a case study of death summaries, spectating and remote soldier control. The session examines how downtime can provide information and support planning for the next engagement.
summary.zh: 本讲以《战意》的死亡回顾、观战和远程指挥士兵为例，讨论如何在等待复活时提供信息与参与方式，帮助玩家准备下一轮战斗。

sessions.title: Keys to Next Level Game Growth (Presented by Google)
sessions.title_zh: 迈向下一阶段游戏增长的关键

summary.en: Google's gaming team discusses strategies for growing mobile game businesses. The session draws on its games research to consider planning and execution in a period of increased play at home.
summary.zh: Google 游戏团队结合其游戏研究讨论移动业务增长策略，围绕居家游玩增加的背景，分享增长计划与执行方面的思考。

sessions.title: Lessons From Theatre That Can Transform XR Experiences
sessions.title_zh: 能够改变 XR 体验的戏剧经验

summary.en: James Horn draws on work with XR and theatre organizations to discuss established theatrical techniques. The talk connects pre-production, storytelling and spatial design with intimacy and audience connection in XR.
summary.zh: James Horn 结合 XR 与戏剧项目，讨论既有戏剧方法如何进入前期制作、叙事和空间设计，并用于思考 XR 中的亲近感与观众联结。

sessions.title: Lessons Learned in Adapting the 'Sea of Thieves' Automated Testing Methodology to 'Minecraft'
sessions.title_zh: 将《盗贼之海》的自动测试方法用于《Minecraft》的经验

summary.en: The session compares automated testing practices in Sea of Thieves and Minecraft. It examines how teams build fast, reliable tests into everyday development and create a culture that supports that work.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍《盗贼之海》自动测试方法向《Minecraft》的迁移，讨论如何将快速、可靠的测试纳入日常开发，以及支持这种实践的团队文化。

sessions.title: Level Design Workshop: The Illusion of Choice
sessions.title_zh: 关卡设计工作坊：选择的幻觉

summary.en: This talk examines psychological and biological perspectives on player choice. Examples from released games show how subtle design decisions influence choices or create an impression of autonomy.
summary.zh: 本讲从心理与生理层面讨论选择机制，并结合已发行游戏，分析设计细节如何影响玩家决策，或营造自主选择的感受。

sessions.title: Level Design Workshop: The Level Design of 'God of War'
sessions.title_zh: 关卡设计工作坊：《战神》的关卡设计

summary.en: Rob Davis explains the creation of six new level-design rules for God of War. The session examines rethinking long-standing series conventions and moving levels from concept through production.
summary.zh: Rob Davis 介绍《战神》六项新关卡设计规则的形成，讨论如何重新审视系列长期惯例，以及关卡从概念到完成的制作方法。

sessions.title: Lifetime Value in the Time of Covid
sessions.title_zh: 疫情时代的生命周期价值

summary.en: Magic: The Gathering Arena provides a case study of iterating a player lifetime-value model through four versions. The discussion covers limited early data, periodic content releases and the disruption of pandemic-era behavior changes.
summary.zh: 本讲以《万智牌：竞技场》生命周期价值模型的四次迭代为例，讨论早期数据有限、内容周期更新和疫情期间玩家行为变化带来的建模难题。

sessions.title: LIVE Ask Me Anything: Q&A with Global Game Jam's Kate Edwards

summary.en: Kate Edwards answers questions about Global Game Jam and her game-industry experience.
summary.zh: Kate Edwards 回答有关 Global Game Jam 及其游戏行业经历的问题。

youtube.title: Ask Me Anything: Q&A with Global Game Jam's Kate Edwards

sessions.title: LIVE Fireside Chat: Amir Rao and Kelly Wallick on 'Hades'
sessions.title_zh: 现场炉边谈话：Amir Rao 与 Kelly Wallick 谈《Hades》

summary.en: Amir Rao and Kelly Wallick reflect on Hades and the studio that created it. Their conversation examines the processes and experiences behind the game and Supergiant's development approach.
summary.zh: Amir Rao 与 Kelly Wallick 回顾《Hades》及其背后的 Supergiant 工作室，讨论游戏形成的过程、团队经历和开发方式。

sessions.title: LIVE Fireside Chat: Geena Davis and Mitu Khandaker on Masculinity in Video Games and the Gaming Community
companies: Geena Davis Institute on Gender in Media
Glow Up Games / NYU Game Center
tags: Geena Davis Institute on Gender in Media
Glow Up Games / NYU Game Center
sessions.title_zh: 现场炉边谈话：Geena Davis 与 Mitu Khandaker 谈游戏及社区中的男性气质

summary.en: Geena Davis and Mitu Khandaker discuss a study of masculinity in popular video games. The conversation considers portrayals and recommendations related to diversity, equity and inclusion.
summary.zh: Geena Davis 与 Mitu Khandaker 围绕热门游戏中的男性气质研究交流，讨论角色呈现，以及促进多样性、公平和包容的建议。

sessions.title: LIVE Fireside Chat: John Murphy, Kevin Zuhn and Adam Saltsman on 'Bugsnax'
sessions.title_zh: 现场炉边谈话：John Murphy、Kevin Zuhn 与 Adam Saltsman 谈《Bugsnax》

summary.en: Young Horses and Finji discuss the inner workings of Bugsnax. The conversation focuses on mechanics, systemic absurdist comedy and the balance between wholesome appeal and horror.
summary.zh: Young Horses 与 Finji 的创作者围绕《Bugsnax》交流，讨论玩法机制、系统化荒诞喜剧，以及温馨感与恐怖之间的把握。

sessions.title: LIVE GDC Main Stage: GDC Plays 'Quake' with John Romero and JP LeBreton

summary.en: John Romero and JP LeBreton play Quake while discussing decisions behind its development.
summary.zh: John Romero 与 JP LeBreton 一边游玩《雷神之锤》，一边讨论开发决策。

sessions.title: Low Poly Modeling: Style Through Economy
sessions.title_zh: 低多边形建模：用精简塑造风格

summary.en: Ethan introduces practical decisions for making low-poly 3D game models with limited art resources. The talk covers common mistakes and how deliberate style choices can guide economical production.
summary.zh: Ethan 为美术资源有限的团队介绍低多边形三维建模，讨论常见问题，以及如何通过明确的风格选择安排精简的资产制作。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: 3D Parametric Face Model and Its Applications in Games
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：三维参数化人脸模型及其游戏应用

summary.en: NetEase describes building a custom parametric face model and techniques derived from it. Applications include creating meshes from images, generating shape and expression variations, and facial performance capture.
summary.zh: 网易介绍自建三维参数化人脸模型的方法，并讨论由图像生成面部网格、从示例扩展形状和表情，以及面部表演捕捉等应用。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Applying 'AlphaZero' to Develop AI in Turn-Based Card Games
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：用 AlphaZero 开发回合制卡牌 AI

summary.en: This talk examines applying AlphaZero to NetEase card games. It covers card modeling, deck training and difficulty control, alongside the limitations of rule-based AI in this setting.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍 AlphaZero 在网易卡牌游戏中的应用，讨论卡牌建模、卡组训练和难度控制，并分析传统规则 AI 在这一场景下的不足。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Creating Cooperative Character Behaviors Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：用深度强化学习创造协作角色行为

summary.en: The presentation explores cooperative deep reinforcement learning, including centralized-critic techniques. A studio example illustrates how objectives and training can be organized for characters that need to work together.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍协作式深度强化学习及集中式评论器等方法，通过工作室实例讨论如何为需要配合的角色设置目标和组织训练。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Creating Game AI by Using Mostly English, with Semantic ML
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：主要用英语与语义机器学习创建游戏 AI

summary.en: Demos explore a natural-language approach to prototyping character behavior with a spreadsheet. The session examines how semantic machine learning can connect player actions and authored content while involving less technical contributors.
summary.zh: 本讲通过演示介绍用自然语言和电子表格搭建角色 AI 原型的方法，讨论语义机器学习如何连接玩家行动与创作内容，并让技术背景较少的成员参与行为设计。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Deep Reinforcement Learning For Navigation
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：用于导航的深度强化学习

summary.en: Ubisoft La Forge examines learned navigation for abilities such as jumping, teleporting and jetpacks. The talk explains agents operating through gamepad input and discusses integration examples, strengths and limitations.
summary.zh: Ubisoft La Forge 探索用深度强化学习处理跳跃、传送和喷气背包等导航能力，介绍通过手柄输入行动的智能体，并讨论接入案例、优势和限制。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Full-Body Animation Generation for Expressive NPCs
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：为富有表现力的 NPC 生成全身动画

summary.en: The session describes deep-learning generation of full-body motion for speaking NPCs. It connects speech prosody, emotion and character traits with facial motion, posture and gestures.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍为说话 NPC 自动生成全身动作的深度学习方法，讨论语音韵律、情绪和角色特征如何对应到面部、姿态与肢体动作。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Identify your Players' Builds from In-Game Data: The BaT Approach
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：从游戏数据识别玩家流派——BaT 方法

summary.en: The talk introduces BaT for grouping large volumes of RPG loot-game data into interpretable player builds. It focuses on the combinatorial complexity that makes conventional unsupervised analysis difficult.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍将大量刷宝 RPG 数据归为可解释玩家流派的 BaT 方法，讨论装备组合爆炸给传统无监督分析带来的困难，以及如何组织有用的流派聚类。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: ML for Art and Game Balancing with Project Chimera
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：Project Chimera 的美术与游戏平衡应用

summary.en: Stadia's research team reviews two Project Chimera experiments: image creation using conditional GANs and style transfer, and balance analysis using reinforcement learning. The talk examines artist guidance, exploit discovery and state-machine tuning.
summary.zh: Stadia 研发团队介绍 Project Chimera 的两项实验：由美术引导的条件生成对抗网络与风格迁移图像流程，以及利用强化学习寻找漏洞和辅助调节游戏状态机。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Smart Tech in 'Hearthstone'
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：《炉石传说》中的智能技术

summary.en: A Blizzard developer discusses data-driven features used across major Hearthstone modes. The session focuses on gameplay applications and collaboration among data scientists, designers, engineers and production staff.
summary.zh: 暴雪开发者介绍《炉石传说》多个模式中的数据驱动功能，讨论其玩法用途，以及数据科学、设计、工程与制作管理之间的协作。

sessions.title: Maintaining Sledgehammer Games' Studio Culture During Rapid Team Growth
sessions.title_zh: 在团队快速扩张时维持 Sledgehammer Games 的文化

summary.en: Alayna Cole reflects on expanding Sledgehammer's Melbourne team while moving to home working. The session examines ways to maintain studio culture and connections across multiple locations during rapid change.
summary.zh: Alayna Cole 回顾 Sledgehammer 墨尔本团队扩张与居家办公并行的经历，讨论快速变化中如何维持工作室文化和多地团队之间的联系。

sessions.title: Making Great VR Games: A Postmortem on Skydance Interactive's 'The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners'

summary.en: Skydance reflects on designing an immersive survival-horror experience for The Walking Dead in VR.
summary.zh: Skydance 回顾《行尸走肉》VR 沉浸式生存恐怖体验的设计。

youtube.title: Making Great VR Games: A Postmortem on Skydance Interactive's The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners

sessions.title: Making Magic: A Business Model for Divergent Thinkers

summary.en: Velan Studios discusses a business approach intended to support unconventional game ideas.
summary.zh: Velan Studios 介绍支持非传统游戏创意的经营思路。

youtube.title: Making Magic: A Business Model for Divergent Thinkers

sessions.title: Making Marketing Mistakes
sessions.title_zh: 营销中的失误

summary.en: This talk examines unsuccessful indie marketing efforts, including empty contests and social-media mistakes. It focuses on responding to errors and turning failed campaigns into useful learning.
summary.zh: 本讲回顾冷清的活动、社交媒体失误等独立游戏营销挫折，讨论出现错误后的调整方式，以及如何把失败的推广尝试转化为经验。

sessions.title: Making Witches Talk in 'DON'T WAKE THE NIGHT'

summary.en: Santo Aveiro Ojeda explores mechanics that convey evocative storytelling in Don't Wake the Night.
summary.zh: Santo Aveiro Ojeda 分享《Don't Wake the Night》中通过机制表达情绪化故事的方法。

youtube.title: Making Witches Talk in 'DON'T WAKE THE NIGHT'

sessions.title: Master of the Katana: Melee Combat in Ghost of Tsushima
sessions.title_zh: 武士刀大师：《对马岛之魂》的近战

summary.en: The developers examine a demanding melee system intended to make player mastery parallel Jin's journey. The talk connects combat difficulty with the story's tactical choices and shares design, technical and human-performance lessons.
summary.zh: 开发者讨论《对马岛之魂》近战系统如何让玩家的熟练过程呼应仁的成长，分析战斗挑战与故事中战术转变的联系，并分享设计、技术和玩家能力方面的发现。

sessions.title: Math In Game Development Summit: Conservative Mesh Decimation for Collision Detection and Occlusion Culling
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发数学峰会：面向碰撞检测与遮挡剔除的保守网格简化

summary.en: The session examines quadric-error mesh decimation and ways to choose conservative vertex positions. It discusses enclosing or enclosed simplified meshes for collision and occlusion, plus quality, performance and stopping criteria.
summary.zh: 本讲分析二次误差度量网格简化，讨论如何选择保守顶点位置，使简化网格包住原网格或位于其内部，以分别服务碰撞与遮挡，并涉及质量、性能和终止条件。

sessions.title: Math in Game Development Summit: Even Faster Math Functions
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发数学峰会：更快的数学函数

summary.en: This advanced talk explores bit-level implementations of mathematical functions, emphasizing FPGAs. Topics include bit heaps, bipartite tables and CORDIC approaches.
summary.zh: 本进阶讲座从比特层面讨论数学函数实现，重点涉及 FPGA，以及位堆、双分表和 CORDIC 等方法。

sessions.title: Math In Game Development Summit: Getting There in Style: Intro to Interpolation and Control Systems
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发数学峰会：优雅抵达——插值与控制系统入门

summary.en: The talk surveys techniques for moving objects toward fixed or changing targets. It offers a framework for choosing interpolation and control methods when repeated lerp operations or ad hoc fixes are insufficient.
summary.zh: 本讲梳理物体向固定或移动目标运动的方法，讨论基础插值、持续控制等场景，并提供在反复套用 lerp 之外选择合适工具的思路。

sessions.title: Math In Game Development Summit: Mathematical Analysis of Classic Card and Board Games
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发数学峰会：经典卡牌与桌游的数学分析

summary.en: Classic games provide examples for Markov chains, graphs, Monte Carlo simulation and probability models. The presentation shows how these techniques can support analysis of balance and fairness in more complex designs.
summary.zh: 本讲以经典卡牌和桌游演示马尔可夫链、图、蒙特卡洛模拟及概率模型，讨论如何用这些方法分析规则、平衡与公平，并扩展到更复杂的游戏。

sessions.title: Math in Game Development Summit: New Developments in Projective Geometric Algebra
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发数学峰会：射影几何代数的新进展

summary.en: The session reviews a four-dimensional homogeneous Grassmann-algebra model before examining geometric views of quaternions and dual quaternions. It then connects those ideas to graphics and animation applications.
summary.zh: 本讲先回顾四维齐次 Grassmann 代数模型，再讨论四元数与对偶四元数的几何来源，并介绍它们在图形和动画中的实际用途。

sessions.title: Math In Game Development Summit: Practical Quaternions: An Easy Guide to 3D Rotations for Non-Mathematicians
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发数学峰会：实用四元数——面向非数学专业者的三维旋转指南

summary.en: Patrick introduces quaternions through practical visualization, debugging and everyday rotation tasks. The session emphasizes an implementer's working methods for understanding and using them.
summary.zh: Patrick 从实际开发中的可视化、调试和旋转操作出发介绍四元数，帮助实现者用常见任务理解并运用这一工具。

sessions.title: Melee AI in 'The Last of Us Part II'
sessions.title_zh: 《最后生还者 第二部》的近战 AI

summary.en: Naughty Dog discusses modular solutions for a more demanding, tightly controlled melee experience. The talk examines how behavior, visuals and controls interact when small inconsistencies become especially noticeable at close range.
summary.zh: Naughty Dog 介绍《最后生还者 第二部》近战体验中的模块化方案，讨论近距离交锋下行为、视觉与控制如何相互影响，以及细小不协调如何被放大。

sessions.title: Mixed Reality Racing Fuses Deeper AR Experience with Physical Gameplay
sessions.title_zh: 混合现实赛车：将更深入的 AR 体验与实体玩法融合

summary.en: Velan Studios explains the core concepts of Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit. The talk examines how physical racing and mixed reality were combined to bring kart gameplay into a player's living room.
summary.zh: Velan Studios 介绍《马力欧卡丁车实况：家庭赛车场》的核心功能与概念，讨论如何将实体赛车和混合现实结合，把卡丁车玩法带进玩家客厅。

sessions.title: Model Collision: Balancing Speed and Size in 'Black Ops Cold War'
sessions.title_zh: 模型碰撞：《黑色行动：冷战》中速度与体积的平衡

summary.en: This technical deep dive examines high-accuracy model-collision optimization in Black Ops Cold War. It focuses on hardware-aware data layout and bit-level choices when balancing runtime speed and memory footprint.
summary.zh: 本技术讲座拆解《黑色行动：冷战》的高精度模型碰撞优化，讨论如何利用硬件特征及细到比特的数据安排，在运行速度与内存占用之间作出选择。

sessions.title: Monetization Strategies That Instantly Maximize Your Game's Profit (Presented by HotPlay)
sessions.title_zh: 提升游戏收益的变现策略

summary.en: HotPlay introduces in-game advertising and coupons that connect players with retailers. Examples from Invictus and Evergleam Hill frame lessons from testing the platform in Thailand's mobile market.
summary.zh: HotPlay 介绍连接玩家与零售商的游戏内广告和优惠券方案，结合《Invictus》《Evergleam Hill》案例，分享在泰国移动市场验证平台的经验。

sessions.title: Monetizing Your App Post iOS 14.5: Different Paths To Success (Presented By MoPub)
sessions.title_zh: iOS 14.5 之后的应用变现：不同的应对道路

summary.en: Scopely's monetization and acquisition perspective frames a discussion of advertising after iOS privacy changes. The session considers business approaches under tighter access to advertising identifiers.
summary.zh: 本讲从 Scopely 的变现与获客视角，讨论 iOS 隐私变化后的广告业务，以及广告标识访问受限时的应对方式。

sessions.title: MORTIS 101: 'FAITH's' Horror Design Toolkit
sessions.title_zh: MORTIS 入门：《FAITH》的恐怖设计工具箱

summary.en: Mason Smith examines eight horror-design tools used in FAITH. Examples address minimalism, vulnerability, mechanics turned against the player and the careful building and breaking of trust.
summary.zh: Mason Smith 通过《FAITH》介绍八种恐怖设计工具，讨论极简表现、脆弱感、反向利用玩法机制，以及如何建立并打破玩家信任。

sessions.title: Motion Matching in 'The Last of Us Part II'
sessions.title_zh: 《最后生还者 第二部》的动作匹配

summary.en: Two Naughty Dog technical animators recount adopting motion matching for The Last of Us Part II. The talk follows early expectations, production difficulties and the solutions developed as the project progressed.
summary.zh: 两位 Naughty Dog 技术动画师回顾《最后生还者 第二部》采用动作匹配的历程，讨论早期设想、制作中遇到的困难，以及团队逐步形成的解决办法。

sessions.title: Multi-Model Approach to Hyper-Personalizing Your Game (Presented by TENTUPLAY)
sessions.title_zh: 用多模型方法深度个性化游戏

summary.en: TENTUPLAY presents player analysis using multiple models for distinct behavioral tendencies. The session examines model selection across genres and lifecycle stages and its use in interpreting retention and purchases.
summary.zh: TENTUPLAY 介绍针对不同玩家行为倾向的多模型分析，讨论如何按类型和生命周期阶段选择模型，以及如何理解留存与购买行为来支持个性化设计。

sessions.title: Not Everything is On Fire All The Time: Making Healthy Workplace Culture a Reality
companies: Glow Up Games / NYU Game Center
tags: Glow Up Games / NYU Game Center
sessions.title_zh: 并非时时都在救火：让健康职场文化成为现实

summary.en: Leaders from companies of different sizes discuss human-centered workplaces and lived company values. The conversation addresses vulnerable leadership, milestones, stress and the habit of treating every task as urgent.
summary.zh: 不同规模公司的负责人交流以人为本的职场建设，讨论如何落实价值观、接纳领导者的脆弱，并应对里程碑、压力与持续紧迫感。

sessions.title: NVIDIA DLSS Overview & Game Integrations (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: NVIDIA DLSS 概览与游戏集成

summary.en: The session explains DLSS technology and the engine requirements for integration. It also covers debugging tools and common image-quality issues developers may encounter.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍 DLSS 的技术基础与引擎接入条件，并讨论集成中的调试工具，以及常见画面质量问题的排查。

sessions.title: NVRTX Artist Guide (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: 面向美术的 NVRTX 指南

summary.en: NVIDIA introduces its RTX branch of Unreal Engine through lighting, denoising, volumetric and inspection tools. Jungle and museum examples support guidance on performance metrics and common rendering issues.
summary.zh: NVIDIA 通过光照、降噪、体积效果和检查工具介绍 Unreal Engine 的 RTX 分支，结合丛林与博物馆场景讨论性能指标及常见渲染问题。

sessions.title: Observability Into Game Server Deployment and Performance Through Instrumentation (Presented by Honeycomb.io)
sessions.title_zh: 通过埋点观测游戏服务器的部署与性能

summary.en: Honeycomb demonstrates instrumentation across a game-server platform, including Kubernetes, services, APIs and deployment pipelines. The session examines how collected telemetry supports questions about system behavior and issue triage.
summary.zh: Honeycomb 介绍游戏服务器平台的埋点与遥测采集，涵盖 Kubernetes、服务、API 和部署流程，讨论如何用这些信息理解系统行为并定位问题。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: 'Pokmon GoFest 2020': Global Challenge Arena
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：《Pokémon GO Fest 2020》的全球挑战竞技场

summary.en: Niantic reviews developing the Global Challenge Arena for a remotely shared Go Fest. The session examines real-time activity reporting and rewards tied to community-wide goals during the pandemic.
summary.zh: Niantic 回顾为远程参与的 Go Fest 开发全球挑战竞技场，介绍实时活动记录、进度汇报和共同目标奖励，讨论疫情期间如何连接分散的玩家。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: 'Rocket League': Scaling for Free to Play
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：《Rocket League》向免费模式扩容

summary.en: This talk follows Rocket League's online-service preparation for its move to free-to-play. It examines the backend scaling work needed for the resulting increase in concurrent players.
summary.zh: 本讲回顾《Rocket League》转向免费模式前的在线服务准备，讨论玩家并发增长给后端带来的要求，以及相应的扩容过程。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: Data Driven Competitive Matchmaking Over Multiple Continents
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：跨洲竞争匹配的数据驱动方法

summary.en: The W3Champions project provides a case study of rankings, team balancing and matchmaking for a global Warcraft III community. The talk examines algorithm choices and the challenges of serving a geographically dispersed competitive player base.
summary.zh: 本讲以 W3Champions 为案例，介绍面向全球《魔兽争霸 III》玩家的排名、队伍平衡和匹配方法，讨论数据分析与跨洲竞技体验中的难题。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: Exploring Services Architecture at Bungie
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：探索 Bungie 的服务架构

summary.en: Bungie reviews the move to a service-driven backend for Destiny. The talk examines architecture built from a Windows-focused starting point, lessons from operation and plans for further growth.
summary.zh: Bungie 回顾《命运》转向服务驱动后端的过程，讨论从以 Windows 为主的基础出发构建架构、运营中积累的经验，以及进一步扩展的思路。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: From R6 Siege to Ubisoft Connect: How Ubisoft Created a Powerful Online Ecosystem
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：从《彩虹六号：围攻》到 Ubisoft Connect——育碧的在线生态

summary.en: Ubisoft examines its managed online platform and its microservice architecture. The session connects game services and shared data with Ubisoft Connect, cross-progression and public-cloud scaling.
summary.zh: 育碧介绍内部托管在线平台及其微服务架构，讨论游戏服务与共享数据如何支撑 Ubisoft Connect、跨平台进度和公有云扩展。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: Leveraging Blockchain in Games to Redefine the Concept of Ownership
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：用区块链重新思考游戏所有权

summary.en: The talk proposes player-owned economies as an approach to grey markets and digital ownership. It discusses blockchain's potential role in transactions and relationships among players, creators, brands and developers.
summary.zh: 本讲围绕灰色市场与数字所有权，提出玩家拥有型经济的构想，讨论区块链可能如何影响交易，以及玩家、创作者、品牌和开发者之间的关系。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: Providing Decision Support Throughout Games' Lifecycles Leveraging Big Data
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：用大数据支持游戏全生命周期决策

summary.en: Thunder Fire UX shares work on handling large volumes of multiplayer behavioral data. The session examines transmission, storage, analysis and mining challenges that motivate the use of big-data tools.
summary.zh: 雷火用户体验团队分享多人游戏行为数据处理经验，讨论大规模传输、存储、分析和挖掘的挑战，以及大数据工具在决策支持中的用途。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: Queuing: Let Data Guide Your Server Opening Strategy
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：排队——让数据指导开服策略

summary.en: Leihuo UX examines real-time queue monitoring across online games. The talk considers server-opening decisions that balance limited capacity, uneven waiting times and the risk of losing players.
summary.zh: 雷火用户体验团队介绍在线游戏的实时排队监测，讨论如何根据服务器容量、不同区服的等待时间和玩家流失风险调整开服策略。

sessions.title: Orchestrating 'Hexagroove's' Junior Talent
sessions.title_zh: 组织《Hexagroove》的年轻人才

summary.en: Ichigoichie reviews managing a team of veterans and inexperienced interns on Hexagroove: Tactical DJ. Coaching, remote relationships and prioritization around available skills provide the focus of this production retrospective.
summary.zh: Ichigoichie 回顾《Hexagroove: Tactical DJ》中资深成员与实习生混合团队的管理，讨论辅导、异地合作，以及如何依据成员技能在紧张计划内安排优先级。

sessions.title: Paint It Black: The Art of 'Sea of Solitude'
sessions.title_zh: 涂成黑色：《孤独之海》的美术

summary.en: Jo-Mei discusses translating Sea of Solitude's 2D style into a 3D environment. Unity tools inspired by a Photoshop workflow and the visual interpretation of loneliness connect production choices with the project's personal themes.
summary.zh: Jo-Mei 介绍《孤独之海》如何将二维风格转为三维场景，讨论模仿 Photoshop 工作方式的 Unity 工具，以及孤独主题和个人经历如何进入视觉表达。

sessions.title: Paths to Success: Japan's Puzzling Mobile Gaming Market (Presented by Pangle)
sessions.title_zh: 成功路径：解读日本移动解谜游戏市场

summary.en: Pangle examines puzzle-game patterns in Japan and differences from Western markets. The session considers approaches across riddles, matching games and room-escape experiences.
summary.zh: Pangle 分析日本移动解谜市场及其与西方市场的差异，讨论谜语、消除和密室逃脱等形式中的设计与市场实践。

sessions.title: Pre-Decisional Support: Accurate, Agile and Active Data Delivery
sessions.title_zh: 决策前支持：准确、敏捷、主动的数据交付

summary.en: Leihuo UX shares its experience operating a data middle office for multiple games. The talk focuses on organizing the team and managing divergent product demands while maintaining scalable support.
summary.zh: 雷火用户体验团队分享为多款游戏服务的数据中台经验，讨论团队架构、差异化产品需求的管理，以及保持支持能力可扩展的方法。

sessions.title: Procedural Systems for "Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales" and "Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart" (Presented by Houdini)
sessions.title_zh: 《漫威蜘蛛侠：迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯》与《瑞奇与叮当：时空跳转》的程序化系统

summary.en: Insomniac offers an overview of procedural systems and tools used to generate open-world content. Examples come from Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales and Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart.
summary.zh: Insomniac 概览用于生成开放世界内容的程序化系统与工具，分享《漫威蜘蛛侠：迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯》和《瑞奇与叮当：时空跳转》的制作实例。

sessions.title: Production Essentials Summit: Cluster Structure: Succeeding at Production with a Wide Portfolio
sessions.title_zh: 制作基础峰会：集群结构——管理多项目制作

summary.en: Veloxia examines a cluster-based team structure through its experience developing several titles. The talk discusses advantages, trade-offs, integration challenges and decisions about when and how to adopt the structure.
summary.zh: Veloxia 结合多个项目讨论集群式团队结构，分析优缺点、整合难题，以及何时采用、如何逐步建立这一组织方式。

sessions.title: Production Essentials Summit: CQ: Superpowers for Excellence in Game Development
sessions.title_zh: 制作基础峰会：CQ——支持优秀游戏开发的文化能力

summary.en: The session introduces cultural intelligence as a framework for game teams. Examples examine communication, risk preferences, inclusion and the role of culture in development decisions.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍文化智力框架，结合团队沟通、风险偏好和包容性等例子，讨论文化因素如何影响游戏开发中的协作与决策。

sessions.title: Production Essentials Summit: Optimizing Remote Production For Your Studio
sessions.title_zh: 制作基础峰会：优化工作室的远程制作

summary.en: The talk surveys project-management systems, knowledge bases and virtual-office practices for remote indie teams. Case studies help frame collaboration standards across disciplines and time zones.
summary.zh: 本讲梳理远程独立团队的项目管理系统、知识库与虚拟办公实践，通过案例讨论跨专业、跨时区合作所需的协作标准。

sessions.title: Promote Your Game with HP OMEN (Presented by HP Inc.)
sessions.title_zh: 通过 HP OMEN 推广游戏

summary.en: HP introduces game-promotion opportunities through OMEN Gaming Hub. The session covers collaboration with its gaming and esports team, including rewards, gallery images and Oasis sharing and streaming features.
summary.zh: HP 介绍通过 OMEN Gaming Hub 推广游戏的机会，讨论如何与其游戏及电竞团队合作，使用奖励、图库和 Oasis 分享与直播功能。

sessions.title: PSA: Games and E-Sports Platforms Need To Be More Social (Presented by Agora)
sessions.title_zh: 游戏与电竞平台需要更多社交功能

summary.en: Agora discusses embedded voice and video for multiplayer games and esports viewing. The session examines social features such as watch parties and their relationship to audience engagement.
summary.zh: Agora 讨论多人游戏与电竞观赛中的内置语音和视频，介绍共同观赛等社交功能，并分析这些互动与受众参与的关系。

sessions.title: Quad Mesh Simplification in Frostbite
sessions.title_zh: Frostbite 中的四边形网格简化

summary.en: Frostbite reviews developing LOD tools that preserve quad topology and edge flow. The talk examines procedural simplification intended to retain editable, animation-friendly character meshes.
summary.zh: Frostbite 回顾保留四边形拓扑与边流的 LOD 工具开发，讨论程序化简化如何兼顾角色网格的后续编辑、光照和动画需求。

sessions.title: Ray Tracing in Your Pocket, Closer Than You Think (Presented by Imagination Technologies)
sessions.title_zh: 口袋中的光线追踪，近在眼前

summary.en: Imagination Technologies examines ray tracing under mobile power, battery and GPU constraints. The presentation discusses technical details and algorithm concepts being explored for mobile implementations.
summary.zh: Imagination Technologies 围绕功耗、电池与移动 GPU 限制讨论光线追踪，介绍面向移动实现的技术细节和算法思路。

sessions.title: Real-Time ML Inference for Mobile Gaming (Presented by Arm)
sessions.title_zh: 移动游戏的实时机器学习推理

summary.en: Arm examines real-time inference while graphics workloads compete for mobile resources. The talk discusses neural-network selection, inference frameworks and pipeline-specific optimizations for game applications.
summary.zh: Arm 讨论图形负载占用资源时如何进行移动实时推理，介绍游戏应用中的神经网络选择、推理框架与针对管线的优化。

sessions.title: Real-Time Short Film 'Windup': Technical Art Production
sessions.title_zh: 实时短片《Windup》的技术美术制作

summary.en: Windup's director, technical artist and animation supervisor discuss producing a film-like look in Unity. The session connects HDRP, Maya, Timeline, Shader Graph, Houdini and VFX Graph within the short's workflow.
summary.zh: 《Windup》的导演、技术美术与动画负责人分享 Unity 实时短片制作，介绍 HDRP、Maya、Timeline、Shader Graph、Houdini 和 VFX Graph 在流程中的配合。

sessions.title: Realities of the Hidden Freelance Crunch
sessions.title_zh: 自由职业者隐形加班的现实

summary.en: Composers Jesse Harlan and Austin Wintory discuss overlapping freelance work and its personal costs. Their stories frame a conversation about recognizing crunch and developing longer-term coping strategies.
summary.zh: 作曲者 Jesse Harlan 与 Austin Wintory 分享自由职业项目重叠、工作堆积的经历，讨论隐形加班对个人状态的影响，以及识别和应对这一问题的长期方法。

sessions.title: Reduce Outages and Increase Performance With a Time Series Database (Presented by InfluxData)
sessions.title_zh: 用时序数据库减少故障并改善性能

summary.en: InfluxData introduces collecting and analyzing large volumes of real-time metrics. The session examines monitoring and alerting as tools for investigating game-system and network problems.
summary.zh: InfluxData 介绍大量实时指标的采集与分析，讨论如何通过集中监测和告警发现并调查游戏系统及网络问题。

sessions.title: Remote Leadership: Challenges and Approaches
sessions.title_zh: 远程领导力：挑战与方法

summary.en: The talk examines leadership during an abrupt move to home working. It addresses team cohesion, communication, IT difficulties and personal pressures, then considers longer-term remote-work practices.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论突然转向居家办公时的领导工作，涵盖团队凝聚力、沟通、IT 问题与个人家庭压力，并思考长期远程协作的安排。

sessions.title: Replicating Chaos: Vehicle Replication in 'Watch Dogs 2'
sessions.title_zh: 同步混沌：《看门狗 2》的车辆网络同步

summary.en: The session examines vehicle trajectory replication and player collisions under network latency. It discusses combining projective velocity blending, snapshot buffering and physics blending, alongside unresolved problems.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍《看门狗 2》如何在网络延迟下同步车辆轨迹与玩家碰撞，讨论投影速度混合、快照缓冲和物理模拟混合的组合应用，以及尚未解决的问题。

sessions.title: Rigging the MetaHumans (Presented by Epic Games - Unreal Engine)
sessions.title_zh: MetaHuman 角色绑定

summary.en: Epic takes a closer look at MetaHuman body rigs in Maya and Unreal Engine. The session discusses customizing those rigs and creating variations for project needs.
summary.zh: Epic 介绍 Maya 与 Unreal Engine 中的 MetaHuman 身体绑定，讨论如何根据项目需求进行定制和制作变化版本。

sessions.title: Rope Simulation in 'Uncharted 4' and 'The Last of Us 2'
sessions.title_zh: 《神秘海域 4》与《最后生还者 2》的绳索模拟

summary.en: Naughty Dog traces rope technology from grappling and winches to freely handled rope puzzles. The talk examines soft-body simulation and the challenge of wrapping a taut rope around collision geometry.
summary.zh: Naughty Dog 回顾绳索技术从抓钩、绞盘到自由操作解谜的演变，介绍软体模拟，以及绷紧绳索绕过碰撞几何时的处理难点。

sessions.title: Rules of the Game 2021: Five Unique Techniques from Distinguished Designers
sessions.title_zh: 2021 游戏规则：五位设计师的独特技巧

summary.en: Five designers each present a practical design technique through short, focused examples. The session examines project-specific rules that can prompt new ways to evaluate and refine a game's design.
summary.zh: 五位设计师各用短讲分享一项实用技巧，结合项目案例讨论设计规则如何帮助重新审视和改进玩法，并启发个人的设计方法。

sessions.title: Samurai Landscapes: Building and Rendering Tsushima Island on PS4
sessions.title_zh: 武士山川：在 PS4 上构建与渲染对马岛

summary.en: Sucker Punch explains world-building tools for authoring millions of natural-environment instances. The talk covers a GPU-interpreted rule language and runtime systems for keeping Tsushima's dense landscape within PS4 budgets.
summary.zh: Sucker Punch 介绍对马岛大量自然物体实例的世界构建工具，包括在 GPU 上解释的规则语言，以及在 PS4 预算内管理密集植被和远景的运行时系统。

sessions.title: Scoring 'Metamorphosis': Music for a Kafkaesque World
sessions.title_zh: 为《Metamorphosis》配乐：卡夫卡式世界的音乐

summary.en: Garry Schyman and Mikolai Stroinski revisit Metamorphosis' score from creative and technical perspectives. The discussion includes twelve-tone writing and Sprechstimme among the techniques used for its musical world.
summary.zh: Garry Schyman 与 Mikolai Stroinski 从创作和技术角度回顾《Metamorphosis》的配乐，讨论十二音写作、念唱等技法如何构成其音乐世界。

sessions.title: Scoring the Open World Samurai Epic: 'Ghost of Tsushima'
sessions.title_zh: 为开放世界武士史诗《对马岛之魂》配乐

summary.en: PlayStation's music team follows the score from production and arrangement to in-game implementation. The talk examines adaptive music, open-world exploration and the workflow supporting a long-form interactive experience.
summary.zh: PlayStation 音乐团队介绍《对马岛之魂》从制作、编曲到游戏实装的配乐流程，讨论自适应音乐、开放世界探索，以及长篇互动体验的音乐组织。

sessions.title: Scriptable Core Dump Debugging and Memory Stomp Tracking
sessions.title_zh: 可脚本化的崩溃转储调试与内存踩踏追踪

summary.en: Naughty Dog presents tools built on Visual Studio's debugger for interactive Python analysis. Case studies show scripting game-specific checks, inspecting memory and tracing complex errors in crash dumps.
summary.zh: Naughty Dog 介绍基于 Visual Studio 调试器的 Python 分析工具，通过案例讨论如何编写游戏专用检查、查看内存，并从崩溃转储追踪复杂错误和内存踩踏。

sessions.title: Sewing a Musical Patchwork: The Music of 'Sackboy: A Big Adventure'
sessions.title_zh: 缝制音乐拼布：《麻布仔大冒险》的音乐

summary.en: Sumo and Sony's music contributors discuss combining licensed tracks with original composition in Sackboy: A Big Adventure. The session examines interactive implementation, music-led level design and the use of remixes and covers.
summary.zh: Sumo 与 Sony 的音乐团队介绍《麻布仔大冒险》授权曲目与原创音乐的结合，讨论交互实装、音乐对关卡的影响，以及混音和翻唱的运用。

sessions.title: Sexy Microtalks: Making with Emotion
tags: University of Miami, Higher Education Video Game Alliance
sessions.title_zh: 性感短讲：带着情感创作

summary.en: Creators discuss games about sex, intimacy and romance through short presentations. Topics range from dialogue and mechanics to code, creative motivations and the challenges of working in this area.
summary.zh: 创作者通过短讲讨论以性、亲密和浪漫为主题的游戏，涵盖对白、机制、代码、创作动机及这一领域的开发挑战。

sessions.title: Sigmoids for Storytellers: Mathematical Solutions to Narrative Problems
sessions.title_zh: 给叙事者的 S 型函数：用数学解决叙事问题

summary.en: Fallen London examples introduce numerical tools for narrative systems, including randomness, difficulty and reward functions, and player-history statistics. The talk also considers documentation and training for writers using these techniques.
summary.zh: 本讲以《Fallen London》说明随机性、难度与奖励函数、玩家历史统计等工具如何用于叙事系统，并讨论怎样通过文档、工具和培训帮助编剧采用这些方法。

sessions.title: Six Powerful Lessons to Learn From Games Research
sessions.title_zh: 从游戏研究中学习的六条经验

summary.en: Mike Schramm shares lessons from focus groups and audience research. The talk examines discovering unknown audience needs, creating authentic characters and IP, and interpreting what players want developers to understand.
summary.zh: Mike Schramm 结合焦点小组和受众研究，讨论如何发现尚未了解的玩家需求、塑造可信角色与 IP，并理解玩家希望开发者听到的信息。

sessions.title: Smart Tech in 'Hearthstone'
sessions.title_zh: 《炉石传说》中的智能技术

summary.en: This session examines data-driven products used in Hearthstone's major modes. It emphasizes the coordination of data science, game design, engineering and production around features that affect play.
summary.zh: 本讲围绕《炉石传说》主要模式中的数据驱动产品展开，介绍数据科学、玩法设计、工程与制作管理如何共同推进影响游玩的功能。

sessions.title: Speech Synthesis in the Context of Video Gaming
sessions.title_zh: 电子游戏语境下的语音合成

summary.en: Ubisoft examines speech synthesis where character voices require strong expressivity. The session surveys current capabilities, methods for controlling expression and the remaining challenges of game-specific applications.
summary.zh: 育碧讨论角色语音需要丰富表现力时的合成技术，梳理现有能力、表达控制方法，以及游戏应用仍面临的难题。

sessions.title: Stop Getting Lost: Make Cognitive Maps, Not Levels
sessions.title_zh: 别再迷路：设计认知地图，而不仅是关卡

summary.en: The talk draws on cognitive science, anthropology and urban planning to examine disorientation in virtual spaces. It considers environmental elements that help players form memorable mental maps.
summary.zh: 本讲借鉴认知科学、人类学与城市规划研究，分析虚拟空间中的迷路问题，讨论哪些环境要素有助于玩家形成清晰、易记的认知地图。

sessions.title: Story Points: Upside Down Project Management
sessions.title_zh: 故事点：颠覆传统的项目管理

summary.en: This session explains shifting estimates from time to story points. It examines how abstract sizing can help teams discuss scope and judge whether a roadmap is plausible.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍从工时估算转向故事点的方法，讨论抽象规模评估如何帮助团队理解工作范围，并判断路线图是否可行。

sessions.title: Strength in Numbers: Empowering Smaller Devs as In Person Collectives
sessions.title_zh: 人多力量大：通过实体联合体支持小型开发者

summary.en: The Game Bakery's founders review running a shared workspace for small studios. Topics include collective representation, facilities, flexible staffing and balancing shared interests with individual businesses.
summary.zh: Game Bakery 创始人回顾小工作室共享办公联合体的建立与维护，讨论集体对外沟通、设施共享、灵活人员协作，以及共同利益与各自业务之间的平衡。

sessions.title: Subscriptions as a Games Model
sessions.title_zh: 订阅作为游戏商业模式

summary.en: Omdia examines the use of subscriptions in games and comparisons with music and video. The talk discusses cloud gaming, benefits and pitfalls, and fitting subscriptions alongside existing monetization models.
summary.zh: Omdia 分析游戏订阅的使用方式，并与音乐和视频订阅比较，讨论云游戏的关联、潜在收益与难点，以及如何与既有变现模式并行。

sessions.title: Succeeding in Game Audio: Tips from a Global Pandemic
sessions.title_zh: 游戏音频职业发展：来自全球疫情的经验

summary.en: Four audio professionals share changes to their work and business during 2020. Short talks cover focused business strategies, education, individual strengths and the social side of social media.
summary.zh: 四位音频从业者通过短讲分享 2020 年调整工作的经历，涉及业务取舍、教育平台、个人优势和社交媒体互动，并讨论哪些做法值得继续。

sessions.title: Supercharging Mobile Performance With Arm Neon and Unity Burst Compiler (Presented by Arm)
sessions.title_zh: 用 Arm Neon 与 Unity Burst 编译器提升移动性能

summary.en: Arm and Unity introduce Neon hardware intrinsics in Burst 1.5. The session discusses using Arm SIMD instructions directly from C# in mobile performance work.
summary.zh: Arm 与 Unity 介绍 Burst 1.5 中的 Neon 硬件内建函数，讨论如何从 C# 直接使用 Arm SIMD 指令开展移动端性能优化。

sessions.title: Tales from the Transition: Remote Game Production Microtalks
sessions.title_zh: 转型故事：远程游戏制作短讲

summary.en: Developers share what went well and poorly when moving to remote production during the pandemic. The microtalks focus on operational changes and preserving studio culture.
summary.zh: 开发者通过短讲回顾疫情期间转向远程制作的得失，讨论工作安排的调整，以及如何在转型中维持工作室文化。

sessions.title: Team Culture and New IP: Creating 'Hardspace: Shipbreaker'
sessions.title_zh: 团队文化与新 IP：创造《Hardspace: Shipbreaker》

summary.en: Blackbird Interactive reviews the culture and production pillars behind Hardspace: Shipbreaker. The talk considers how a small team with a limited budget balanced creative exploration and execution.
summary.zh: Blackbird Interactive 回顾《Hardspace: Shipbreaker》的团队文化与制作支柱，讨论小团队在预算有限时如何兼顾创意探索与执行。

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: !Games: Technical Art Outside of Gamedev
sessions.title_zh: 技术美术峰会：!Games——游戏开发之外的技术美术

summary.en: Technical artists from outside traditional game production discuss their work and careers. The conversation examines how technical-art skills transfer to other industries and applications.
summary.zh: 传统游戏制作之外的技术美术从业者分享工作和职业经历，讨论相关技能如何用于其他行业与应用。

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: Better Computer Graphics through Understanding of Human Visual System
sessions.title_zh: 技术美术峰会：理解人类视觉系统，改善计算机图形

summary.en: The talk surveys human perception of color, intensity, shape and motion. It connects those characteristics to camera design, anti-aliasing, lighting and decisions about where rendering effort is most perceptible.
summary.zh: 本讲梳理人类对色彩、亮度、形状和运动的感知，讨论这些特点对相机、抗锯齿和光照的影响，以及如何据此分配渲染计算。

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: Global Development In a Time Of COVID
sessions.title_zh: 技术美术峰会：疫情时期的全球开发

summary.en: EA Create Shanghai explains technical support for external partners and distributed game teams. The session covers infrastructure, communication, vendor onboarding and training, including adaptations made during 2020.
summary.zh: EA Create 上海团队介绍面向外部合作方与全球项目的技术支持，讨论基础设施、沟通、供应商接入和培训，以及 2020 年所作的调整。

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: Real Time Level Surface Volumetric Simulation Reductions
sessions.title_zh: 技术美术峰会：用于实时体积模拟的等值面简化

summary.en: This session considers level surfaces as a way to reduce the cost of visualizing volumetric simulations. It discusses representing particles and fluid surfaces while preserving visible interaction with other geometry.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论用等值面降低体积模拟可视化计算量的思路，涉及粒子和流体表面的表现，以及如何保留与其他几何体的深度交互。

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: The Art of Not Reinventing the Wheel in 'Wild Rift' Asset Pipeline
sessions.title_zh: 技术美术峰会：《Wild Rift》资产管线中避免重复造轮子的艺术

summary.en: The Wild Rift team examines an asset-analysis tool built around existing artist and engineering workflows. The talk follows the constraints, implementation and philosophy behind managing a rapidly expanding art library.
summary.zh: 《Wild Rift》团队介绍围绕既有美术与工程流程构建的资产分析工具，讨论快速扩大的资源库管理需求、实现限制，以及避免重复建设的设计思路。

sessions.title: Tencent Game AI: Cutting-Edge AI for Gaming and the Future Beyond (Presented by Tencent AI Lab)
sessions.title_zh: 腾讯游戏 AI：前沿游戏 AI 及更广阔的未来

summary.en: Tencent surveys AI applications in production, player experience and game operations through internal case studies. The talk also considers possible connections with adjacent industries and increasingly integrated virtual worlds.
summary.zh: 腾讯通过内部案例梳理 AI 在制作、玩家体验和运营中的用途，并讨论相关行业及虚实融合世界中的后续发展方向。

sessions.title: Tencent Game AI: Intelligent NPC in 3D FPS Games (Presented by Tencent AI Lab)
sessions.title_zh: 腾讯游戏 AI：三维 FPS 中的智能 NPC

summary.en: Tencent describes combining reinforcement learning and generative adversarial imitation learning for FPS agents. Call of Duty Mobile examples illustrate full-game capabilities, human-like behavior and possible commercial uses.
summary.zh: 腾讯介绍结合强化学习与生成对抗模仿学习的 FPS 智能体，借《使命召唤手游》案例讨论完整游玩能力、类人行为及潜在业务用途。

sessions.title: Tencent Game AI: The Techniques and Applications of WukongAI in MOBA Game (Presented by Tencent AI Lab)
sessions.title_zh: 腾讯游戏 AI：悟空 AI 在 MOBA 中的技术与应用

summary.en: Wukong AI provides a case study of learning to play Honor of Kings across many heroes. The talk examines cooperation, strategy diversity, human-like behavior and training methods such as self-play, distillation and tree search.
summary.zh: 本讲以《王者荣耀》的悟空 AI 为例，讨论多英雄学习中的协作、策略多样性和类人行为，并介绍自博弈、策略蒸馏与树搜索等训练方法。

sessions.title: Texturing Pipeline for the Characters of Deathloop (Presented by Adobe)
sessions.title_zh: 《Deathloop》角色的纹理制作流程

summary.en: Arkane explains its character-material and texturing organization for Deathloop. Substance Designer material samples and a detailed Painter file walkthrough show how the team's visual brief informed production choices.
summary.zh: Arkane 介绍《Deathloop》角色材质与纹理的组织方式，通过 Substance Designer 材质示例和 Painter 文件逐层讲解，说明视觉目标如何落实到制作中。

sessions.title: The Animation Summit LIVE AMA!
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会现场有问必答

summary.en: Eight professionals answer animation questions from a range of production backgrounds. The session brings together animation, technical art, motion capture and hand-keyed work across independent and AAA teams.
summary.zh: 八位从业者围绕动画现场答疑，专业覆盖动画、技术美术、动作捕捉与手 K 制作，汇集独立和 AAA 团队的不同经验。

sessions.title: The Art of 'Ori and the Will of the Wisps'
sessions.title_zh: 《奥日与萤火意志》的美术

summary.en: Moon Studios examines the visual principles and technical methods behind Ori and the Will of the Wisps. Scene-building examples illustrate iteration, while the talk also discusses remote studio organization and art-production challenges.
summary.zh: Moon Studios 介绍《奥日与萤火意志》的视觉原则和技术方法，通过场景构建展示美术迭代，并讨论跨国远程团队的组织方式及制作难题。

sessions.title: The Art of 'Triage' in Online Game Development
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏开发中的取舍艺术

summary.en: The talk examines prioritization throughout an online game's lifecycle under time, budget and staffing constraints. It focuses on defining a viable launch scope and maintaining quality while preparing fixes and future content.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论在线游戏各阶段如何在时间、预算与人员限制下安排取舍，重点涉及首发可行范围、质量控制，以及上线修复和后续内容之间的平衡。

sessions.title: The Best Times to Monetize & Acquire Users in Asian Market (Presented by Pangle)
sessions.title_zh: 亚洲市场中变现与获客的时机

summary.en: Pangle examines seasonal changes in Asian game revenue and advertising spend. The discussion connects player behavior with cultural traditions and holiday patterns.
summary.zh: Pangle 分析亚洲游戏收入与广告支出的季节变化，讨论文化传统、节庆与玩家加入和游玩时间之间的关系。

sessions.title: The Calm in the Storm: An Introvert's Guide to Success
sessions.title_zh: 风暴中的平静：内向者的发展指南

summary.en: Joshua Huber combines research and personal experience as an introverted developer and lead. The talk examines studio inclusion, using individual strengths and the effects of home working.
summary.zh: Joshua Huber 结合研究和自身作为内向开发者、负责人的经历，讨论工作室如何包容不同性格、内向者怎样发挥优势，以及居家办公的影响。

sessions.title: The Casual (but Regal) Swipe: Creating Game Mechanics in 'Reigns'
sessions.title_zh: 轻松而庄严的一划：《Reigns》的玩法机制创作

summary.en: François Alliot discusses building Reigns around a swipe mechanic and a defined tone. The session examines constraints, exploratory writing and code, and a design that evolved through repeated creation and revision.
summary.zh: François Alliot 回顾《Reigns》围绕滑动机制与整体基调展开的创作，讨论限制条件、探索式写作和编程，以及设计如何在持续制作与修改中演变。

sessions.title: The Crypto Model for Gaming and the Metaverse (Presented by IMVU)
sessions.title_zh: 游戏与元宇宙的加密资产模式

summary.en: Together Labs/IMVU discusses the introduction of VCOIN and changes in its virtual economy. The session considers what that development could mean for the broader gaming and metaverse ecosystem.
summary.zh: Together Labs/IMVU 介绍 VCOIN 的推出及其虚拟经济变化，讨论这一发展对游戏和元宇宙生态可能产生的意义。

sessions.title: The Defining Themes of the Modern Console Market
sessions.title_zh: 现代主机市场的关键主题

summary.en: Omdia compares outgoing and incoming console generations through market data. Topics include sales cycles, ecosystems, regional markets, digital hardware, hybrid business models and back-catalogue use.
summary.zh: Omdia 结合市场数据对照新旧主机世代，讨论销售周期、生态系统、地区市场、数字硬件、混合商业模式与旧作库运营。

sessions.title: The Impossible Quest: Getting a Job in Games
tags: Diana Boden & Gamma Minus & VestGames, Nukklear
sessions.title_zh: 不可能的任务：在游戏行业找到工作

summary.en: Developers share their paths from newcomers to professionals and discuss application strategies. The session examines hiring obstacles, portfolio decisions and how rejection can inform a later attempt.
summary.zh: 多位开发者分享从新人到从业者的经历，讨论招聘障碍、作品集选择和申请策略，以及如何从拒绝反馈中调整后续尝试。

sessions.title: The Jackbox Party Pack Unboxed: How and Why We Make a Pack of 5 Games Every Year
sessions.title_zh: 拆开《Jackbox Party Pack》：为何每年制作五款游戏

summary.en: Jackbox reviews the process behind selecting, testing and iterating five-game party collections. The talk considers idea generation, production timing and how the approach changed across the series.
summary.zh: Jackbox 回顾年度五款派对游戏合集的创意筛选、测试与迭代流程，讨论不同游戏进入制作的时机，以及系列发展中流程的变化。

sessions.title: The Music of 'BATTLETECH': Big Sound on a Budget
sessions.title_zh: 《BATTLETECH》的音乐：有限预算下的大声音

summary.en: Jon discusses composing and implementing Battletech's interactive score through its Wwise project. Recording choices, reuse, mock-ups and early planning illustrate how a limited budget shaped the workflow.
summary.zh: Jon 通过《BATTLETECH》的 Wwise 工程介绍互动配乐制作，讨论录音与模拟音源的选择、素材复用，以及如何在有限预算下提前规划交互和录制。

sessions.title: The Pandora's Box of Modding in 'Arma' Games
sessions.title_zh: 《Arma》模组开发的潘多拉魔盒
