summary.en: Karel Moricky discusses designing Arma as a platform for user creations. The talk examines openness and control, supporting modders and responding when community projects outgrow the original game.
summary.zh: Karel Moricky 讨论将《Arma》设计为玩家创作平台的思路，分析开放与控制、模组作者支持，以及社区作品影响力超过原作时的应对。

sessions.title: The Power of Introspection: The Fuel That Keeps Teams Resilient
sessions.title_zh: 内省的力量：维持团队韧性的燃料

summary.en: Yea Ji examines introspection at individual, managerial and organizational levels. The talk connects reflection habits with leadership resources, culture and responses to burnout and turnover.
summary.zh: Yea Ji 从个人、管理者和组织层面讨论内省，分析反思习惯、领导支持与文化建设如何参与应对倦怠和人员流动。

sessions.title: The Technology Behind NVRTX (Presented by NVIDIA)
sessions.title_zh: NVRTX 背后的技术

summary.en: NVIDIA reviews challenges in adding ray tracing to game environments. The session outlines solutions developed within its curated Unreal Engine 4 branches.
summary.zh: NVIDIA 回顾游戏环境接入光线追踪时的难题，并介绍其 Unreal Engine 4 定制分支中针对这些问题形成的方案。

sessions.title: Through the Storm: Shipping 'Assassin's Creed Valhalla' during a Global Pandemic
sessions.title_zh: 穿越风暴：在全球疫情中交付《刺客信条：英灵殿》

summary.en: Valhalla's producer reviews the project's production phases during the pandemic. The retrospective focuses on leadership decisions that supported completing and shipping the game.
summary.zh: 《刺客信条：英灵殿》的制作人回顾疫情期间各个制作阶段，重点讨论从项目领导视角作出的决策，以及这些选择与最终交付的联系。

sessions.title: Tools Live Longer Than Games Do: What I Learned About Tools Development From Games Industry Legends
sessions.title_zh: 工具比游戏更长寿：向行业前辈学习工具开发

summary.en: David Lightbown summarizes interviews with creators of classic game tools, including John Romero and Tim Sweeney. The talk draws high-level lessons from their histories for current tool developers.
summary.zh: David Lightbown 汇集对 John Romero、Tim Sweeney 等经典游戏工具创作者的访谈，整理工具开发史中的经验，供当代工具开发者参考。

sessions.title: Tools Summit: Cryptic Studios' Magic Legends: FX Engine Support for Artists
sessions.title_zh: 工具峰会：Cryptic Studios《Magic: Legends》的美术特效引擎支持

summary.en: Cryptic presents in-game tools for authoring, integrating and debugging effects. The session examines artist control alongside safeguards for generated scripts, resource use and technical troubleshooting.
summary.zh: Cryptic 介绍《Magic: Legends》游戏内的特效创作、集成和调试工具，讨论如何赋予美术控制能力，同时检查生成脚本、资源用量并辅助技术排错。

sessions.title: Tools Summit: Embedded Scripting with Zero Overhead in Final Builds
sessions.title_zh: 工具峰会：最终构建中的零额外开销嵌入式脚本

summary.en: Deck13 reviews scripting integration in its Fledge engine, including hot reload and debugging. Earlier approaches provide context for the choices made to support agile workflows while targeting no added runtime cost in final builds.
summary.zh: Deck13 回顾 Fledge 引擎脚本系统的整合，介绍热重载与调试，并对照早期方案，讨论如何支持敏捷工作流及最终构建不增加运行开销的目标。

sessions.title: Tools Summit: Free Up the Cognitive Load: UX in Animation Workflow
sessions.title_zh: 工具峰会：释放认知负担——动画流程中的用户体验

summary.en: Three animation-tool examples illustrate how interfaces place demands on users' attention and working capacity. The talk examines ways tool developers can reduce cognitive load, particularly in home-working conditions.
summary.zh: 本讲通过三款动画工具分析界面对注意力和认知能力的要求，讨论工具开发者如何降低认知负担，尤其考虑居家办公下的使用状态。

sessions.title: Tools Summit: How Ubisoft Builds Tools that Are More "Intuitive"
sessions.title_zh: 工具峰会：育碧如何构建更直观的工具

summary.en: Ubisoft examines why users perceive a tool as intuitive. The session discusses consistent UX patterns and how to create and maintain patterns suited to a studio's development needs.
summary.zh: 育碧讨论用户为何会觉得工具直观，介绍一致的 UX 模式及其作用，以及如何针对工作室需求建立和维护这些模式。

sessions.title: Tools Summit: The Rust Programming Language for Game Tooling
sessions.title_zh: 工具峰会：将 Rust 用于游戏工具开发

summary.en: Treyarch shares experience gradually introducing Rust into its tools and pipeline. The talk examines opportunities, integration challenges and the language's place in a game-tool programmer's toolkit.
summary.zh: Treyarch 分享逐步将 Rust 引入工具与管线的经历，讨论它带来的机会、整合难题，以及在游戏工具开发中的适用位置。

sessions.title: Torch Them All: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Make Fire
sessions.title_zh: 点燃一切：我如何放下忧虑，开始制作火焰

summary.en: Ubisoft La Forge's Torch initiative examines the mathematical and engineering barriers to real-time fluid effects. The talk considers revised physical models and machine-learning support under tight game-performance budgets.
summary.zh: 育碧 La Forge 的 Torch 项目讨论实时流体特效的数学与工程障碍，介绍在游戏计算预算下调整物理模型、结合机器学习的探索方向。

sessions.title: Unity Fireside Chat: The Next-Gen Console Opportunity (Presented by Unity Technologies)
sessions.title_zh: Unity 炉边谈话：新一代主机的机会

summary.en: Unity's Mike Geig talks with Oddworld: Soulstorm executive producer Bennie Terry III. Their conversation examines the challenges and experiences of developing for a new console generation.
summary.zh: Unity 的 Mike Geig 与《Oddworld: Soulstorm》执行制作人 Bennie Terry III 对谈，讨论新一代主机项目的开发挑战与经验。

sessions.title: Universals vs. Differentiators: A Tale of Two Motivations
sessions.title_zh: 共性与差异：两种动机视角

summary.en: The talk compares universal-needs and differentiating-preferences approaches to player motivation. It examines the questions each can answer and uses data-driven cases to show how their insights differ.
summary.zh: 本讲比较从普遍需求和个体差异出发研究玩家动机的两种视角，讨论各自适合回答的问题，并通过数据案例说明它们产生的不同认识。

sessions.title: Unreal Engine in 2021: MetaHumans, Quixel, and Beyond (Presented by Epic Games - Unreal Engine)
sessions.title_zh: 2021 年的 Unreal Engine：MetaHuman、Quixel 及更多

summary.en: Ari Arnbjörnsson tours Epic's wider development ecosystem beyond the engine. The session introduces Epic Online Services, Quixel Megascans, MetaHuman Creator and RAD tools in relation to production workflows.
summary.zh: Ari Arnbjörnsson 概览 Epic 引擎之外的开发生态，介绍 Epic Online Services、Quixel Megascans、MetaHuman Creator 和 RAD 工具在制作流程中的用途。

sessions.title: User Acquisition Post ATT: It's Time To Take Action (Presented by MoPub)
sessions.title_zh: ATT 之后的用户获取：采取行动的时候到了

summary.en: Eastside Games shares its approach to mobile user acquisition following iOS 14.5 privacy changes. The session discusses practices for adapting marketing decisions to the changing environment.
summary.zh: Eastside Games 分享 iOS 14.5 隐私变化后的移动获客做法，讨论营销决策如何适应新的环境。

sessions.title: Using Advanced Competitive Analysis to Thrive in a Competitive Market
sessions.title_zh: 运用进阶竞品分析应对竞争市场

summary.en: The talk examines public data for identifying competitor marketing activity, estimating revenue and building targeted media lists. It focuses on a repeatable analysis method for planning game promotion.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍如何使用公开数据识别竞品营销活动、估计收入并建立目标媒体名单，重点讨论支持推广策略的竞品分析方法。

sessions.title: Using Brain Science to Engage Across Generational and Age Differences
sessions.title_zh: 用脑科学促进跨代际与年龄协作

summary.en: This session examines age-related differences and generational assumptions in game teams. Research and discussion exercises frame ways to address stereotypes, shared needs and collaboration across ages.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论游戏团队中的年龄差异与代际观念，结合研究和交流练习，分析刻板印象、共同需求及跨年龄合作方式。

sessions.title: Using PlayFab Party to Integrate Networking and Voice into Your Game (Presented by Microsoft)
sessions.title_zh: 用 PlayFab Party 将网络与语音集成到游戏中

summary.en: Microsoft introduces PlayFab Party's multiplayer networking and communication features. The session examines cross-platform data, voice and text alongside transcription, speech synthesis and translation support.
summary.zh: Microsoft 介绍 PlayFab Party 的多人网络与通信功能，讨论跨平台数据、语音和文字，以及转写、语音合成和翻译支持。

sessions.title: UX Summit: Approaching Accessibility in Production: A Practical Mindset for Developers
sessions.title_zh: UX 峰会：在制作中推进无障碍——开发者的实用思维

summary.en: The talk offers language for discussing accessibility changes across development teams. It uses the idea of fundamental alteration to examine which adjustments affect a game's core and to guide actionable discussions.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍团队讨论无障碍功能时可采用的概念与表达，以“根本性改变”为切入点，分析调整是否影响核心体验，并帮助将讨论转为可执行方案。

sessions.title: UX Summit: Do No Harm: Ethical Design for Emotionally Heavy Games
sessions.title_zh: UX 峰会：避免伤害——情绪沉重游戏的伦理设计

summary.en: Kelli Dunlap adapts psychological ethical standards for game designers handling intense or traumatic subjects. The session considers player care when representing vulnerable groups, mental illness and other sensitive experiences.
summary.zh: Kelli Dunlap 将心理学伦理标准转化为游戏设计参考，讨论涉及弱势群体、精神困扰或创伤等沉重主题时，如何考虑玩家关怀与潜在伤害。

sessions.title: UX Summit: Expanding the Dreamiverse: Making Dreams an Experience for Everyone
sessions.title_zh: UX 峰会：扩展 Dreamiverse——让每个人都能体验《Dreams》

summary.en: Media Molecule reviews how user research shaped Dreams from an internal creative suite into a broader toolset. UI, controls, tutorials and onboarding illustrate the iterative work behind accessible user-generated-content tools.
summary.zh: Media Molecule 回顾用户研究如何推动《Dreams》从内部创作工具走向更广泛用户，通过界面、控制、教程与入门引导说明 UGC 工具的迭代过程。

sessions.title: UX Summit: History Shaping Design: Learning UX through the Evolution Of Playing Cards
sessions.title_zh: UX 峰会：历史塑造设计——从扑克牌演变学习用户体验

summary.en: Julia Keren-Detar uses playing-card history to examine enduring UX ideas. Function, consistency, recognition and cognitive load provide connections between tabletop traditions and modern game interfaces.
summary.zh: Julia Keren-Detar 借扑克牌历史讨论长期有效的 UX 思路，从功能、一致性、识别和认知负担等方面，联系传统纸牌与现代游戏界面。

sessions.title: UX Summit: LIVE State of Game UX
sessions.title_zh: UX 峰会：游戏用户体验现状现场谈

summary.en: The summit's advisors take stock of UX as both a mindset and a practice in games. The conversation considers progress, persistent misconceptions and challenges involving inclusion and ethics.
summary.zh: 峰会顾问回顾 UX 在游戏行业中的理念与实践，讨论已有进展、仍存的误解，以及包容性和伦理等当前难题。

sessions.title: UX Summit: UX Buy In through Trust: Lessons Learned from DICE
sessions.title_zh: UX 峰会：通过信任争取支持——来自 DICE 的经验

summary.en: Erik discusses building trust in UX within DICE and across disciplines. Battlefield feature examples illustrate ways to work with stakeholders and strengthen a team's UX processes.
summary.zh: Erik 分享 DICE 如何在工作室和不同专业之间建立对 UX 的信任，通过《战地》功能开发案例，讨论争取相关方支持与改进协作流程的方法。

sessions.title: Vicon Motion Systems X Dimension Studios: Metahumans Virtual Production Overview (Presented by Vicon Motion Systems)
sessions.title_zh: Vicon 与 Dimension Studios：MetaHuman 虚拟制作概览

summary.en: The teams introduce Akuma, a short made with Unreal Engine and MetaHuman characters. The session looks behind the production at motion capture, Vicon's Shōgun software and real-time digital-human workflows.
summary.zh: Vicon 与 Dimension Studios 介绍采用 Unreal Engine 和 MetaHuman 的短片《Akuma》，分享动作捕捉、Shōgun 软件及实时数字人流程的幕后制作。

sessions.title: Visual Effects Summit: An Explosive New Spider-Man: Creating VFX for Miles Morales
sessions.title_zh: 视觉特效峰会：全新爆发力——为迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯制作特效

summary.en: Bryanna Lindsey discusses the VFX team's work on Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales. The session examines production challenges and the effects solutions developed for the PS5 launch title.
summary.zh: Bryanna Lindsey 介绍《漫威蜘蛛侠：迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯》的特效团队工作，讨论面向 PS5 首发项目的制作挑战及相应解决方案。

sessions.title: Visual Effects Summit: How to Build Complex VFX Systems With Simple Controls
sessions.title_zh: 视觉特效峰会：用简单控制构建复杂特效系统

summary.en: This talk examines organizing interactive VFX to avoid unmanageable node networks. It discusses extensibility, maintenance and debugging in tools such as Niagara and Unity VFX Graph.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论如何组织互动特效，避免节点网络失控，围绕 Niagara、Unity VFX Graph 等工具介绍便于扩展、维护和调试的设计思路。

sessions.title: Visual Effects Summit: Shader Sauce: How to Use Shaders to Create Stylized VFX
sessions.title_zh: 视觉特效峰会：着色器秘方——用着色器创造风格化特效

summary.en: Veer introduces shader concepts and reusable techniques for stylized VFX. Practical examples show how a foundational library can support quick prototypes and layered, more intricate effects.
summary.zh: Veer 通过实例介绍风格化特效的基础着色器概念与可复用技巧，讨论如何建立基础库以支持快速原型，并通过叠加形成更复杂的效果。

sessions.title: Visual Effects Summit: The Subtle Art of Not Making VFX
sessions.title_zh: 视觉特效峰会：不制作特效时的微妙艺术

summary.en: The talk examines the interpersonal side of a VFX career. It focuses on communication, collaboration and confidence when experiments fail, alongside an artist's technical practice.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论特效工作中的人际与协作能力，重点涉及沟通、合作，以及实验失败时保持信心，补充技术制作之外的职业经验。

sessions.title: Visual Effects Summit: Where Are My Particles? Debugging Techniques for VFX in Unreal 4
sessions.title_zh: 视觉特效峰会：我的粒子去哪了——Unreal 4 特效调试技巧

summary.en: FXVille demonstrates particle and VFX debugging in Unreal Engine 4. Niagara tools, Blueprints and materials are used to visualize positions, gameplay data and implementation logic.
summary.zh: FXVille 演示 Unreal Engine 4 中的粒子与特效调试，介绍如何使用 Niagara 工具、蓝图和材质可视化位置、玩法数据及实现逻辑。

sessions.title: War Stories from Azeroth
sessions.title_zh: 来自艾泽拉斯的战斗故事

summary.en: World of Warcraft's server team revisits four operational stories, including major events and expansion launches. The talk examines load balancing, monitoring, code integration and development practices in a long-running live game.
summary.zh: 《魔兽世界》服务器团队通过大型事件和资料片上线等四段经历，讨论负载均衡、性能监测、代码整合及长期运营中的开发实践。

sessions.title: What Can Game Designers Learn from Competitive Reality Shows
sessions.title_zh: 游戏设计师能从竞技真人秀中学到什么

summary.en: Competitive reality shows provide examples of simple rules producing strategy, emergent narrative and varied play. The talk considers what these formats can teach designers about player freedom and experiences outside authorial control.
summary.zh: 本讲从竞技真人秀的简明规则、策略和涌现叙事出发，讨论当玩家拥有更多自由时，设计者如何创造不完全受作者控制的丰富体验。

sessions.title: Who Owns Reality?
sessions.title_zh: 谁拥有现实？

summary.en: The presentation examines rights questions when games depict real places, objects, brands and people. It also discusses approaches to taking inspiration from protected material when creating original assets.
summary.zh: 本讲讨论游戏再现现实地点、物品、品牌与人物时的权利问题，并介绍从受保护素材汲取灵感、制作原创资产时的处理思路。

sessions.title: Why Should We Use 100 Phone Interviews to Solve the Problem
sessions.title_zh: 为什么要用一百次电话访谈解决问题

summary.en: This session introduces a one-hundred-participant phone-survey approach used in the Ghost mobile game. It discusses connecting that research method with development and long-term operation.
summary.zh: 本讲介绍在 Ghost 手游中采用的一百例电话调研方法，讨论这种研究方式如何与游戏开发及长期运营相结合。

sessions.title: World of Tanks Blitz: The Importance of Data in Automated Performance Testing (Presented by Arm)
sessions.title_zh: 《坦克世界：闪击战》：数据在自动性能测试中的重要性

summary.en: Wargaming's MS-1 studio explains its automated performance-testing workflow for varied mobile devices. The talk examines Arm Mobile Studio data in continuous integration and its use in analyzing changes and regressions.
summary.zh: Wargaming 的 MS-1 工作室介绍覆盖不同移动设备的自动性能测试流程，讨论持续集成中的 Arm Mobile Studio 数据如何用于变化分析和性能回退管理。

sessions.title: You shall not pass! Securing game workloads with AWS (Presented by Amazon Web Services)
sessions.title_zh: 你休想通过：用 AWS 保护游戏工作负载

summary.en: AWS introduces cloud-security tools for protecting games, studios and players. The session examines DDoS protection, bots, rate limiting and client verification with services including Shield, WAF and CloudFront.
summary.zh: AWS 介绍面向游戏、工作室与玩家的云安全工具，讨论使用 Shield、WAF、CloudFront 等服务处理 DDoS、机器人、限流与客户端验证问题。

sessions.title: Zen of Streaming: Building and Loading 'Ghost of Tsushima'
sessions.title_zh: 流式加载之禅：《对马岛之魂》的构建与加载

summary.en: Sucker Punch reviews its move to a fine-grained streaming model for Ghost of Tsushima. The talk covers world-building changes and memory, disc and performance trade-offs across terrain, AI, physics and rendering.
summary.zh: Sucker Punch 回顾《对马岛之魂》转向细粒度流式加载的过程，讨论世界构建方式的演变，以及地形、AI、物理和渲染等系统的内存、磁盘与性能取舍。
